clean_body: | | | | ---|--- | | | October 29, 2026 | ---|---|---|--- | | | Senate Update: Bringing Down Costs while Fighting a Lawless and Corrupt Administration This fall, we face challenges on a number of fronts: families across the country continue to be squeezed by rising prices, the Trump Administration is escalating its attacks on our elections, and unchecked advances in artificial intelligence pose growing risks to our safety, security, and workforce. At the same time, President Trump's illegal and senseless war in Iran continues to cost American lives and drive up prices here at home. The Trump Administration also continues to engage in an all-out assault on immigrant communities across the United States with their - including by targeting people who have lived and worked here legally for years under Temporary Protected Status (TPS). I recently hosted a before Congress and the American people highlighting the critical role TPS holders play in communities across the country. We heard from community leaders and employers, including Carlos Raba, Chef and Owner of Clavel in Baltimore, about families facing separation, businesses losing employees, and the tragic consequences of ICE's of former TPS holders who are being forced back to unsafe countries. These are our who have contributed so much to our communities. In fact, a report from Forward US published earlier this year showed that TPS holders contribute about $29 billion every year to the US economy and pay $7.8 billion in combined federal payroll, state, and local taxes. Given their long-established roots, stripping away employment rights and forcing people from their homes will deliver severe economic shocks across the nation. I will keep pushing to pass my to provide qualified TPS holders and Deferred Enforced Departure recipients with a pathway to lawful permanent residency and the certainty these families deserve. I am fighting back against these abuses while I work to continue delivering results for communities across Maryland. Here's the latest: Fighting to Make Life More Affordable President Trump promised American workers a "golden age," yet he has delivered another Gilded Age only for billionaires and big corporations, while everyday Americans continue to struggle to make ends meet. As of August, the average Maryland household had paid more than $3,700 in additional costs for everyday goods and services under President Trump. His and senseless war in Iran have pushed prices even higher. Families felt that squeeze as students returned to school. The cost of a typical basket of school supplies - including notebooks, lunch boxes, and index cards - increased nearly 8 percent compared to last year, while the cost of a typical school lunch rose 11 percent. And after Trump and Congressional Republicans to finance tax breaks for billionaires and wealthy corporations, more families are being forced to stretch already-tight budgets to put food on the table. Hungry kids can't learn. This is cruelty as a policy choice. Meanwhile, Trump's own Administration has reported that the going to workers is now the lowest ever recorded. In the years immediately following World War II, roughly 65 percent of economic growth went into workers' pocketbooks. Today, that figure stands at just 52.8 percent. As corporate profits skyrocket, working people are being stiffed. I am fighting to pass responsible funding bills that lower costs, protect essential services, and invest in Maryland communities - not another blank check for Trump's illegal war or more giveaways to those at the very top. We need to shake up this rigged system and ensure working people get their fair share. I will continue fighting to end Trump's sweeping tariff taxes, lower costs for Maryland families, and build an economy that works for everyone. Pumping the Brakes on Dangerous Frontier AI We are hearing from the people building frontier artificial intelligence models about the risks that unregulated development poses today. We don't need to take every word at face value to grasp the broader point: the people developing this technology are concerned about the loss of human control. Those risks became even more urgent with OpenAI's release of its latest model, GPT-6 Astra. OpenAI has acknowledged that its ability to monitor the model's internal operations has decreased, that its safety systems may miss dangerous behavior, and that the company may be unable to detect whether Astra is deliberately concealing its capabilities during safety testing. Those concerns come after multiple incidents in which OpenAI's models broke out of their "containment" during evaluations and caused security failures. That's why I'm pushing OpenAI CEO Sam Altman for about the company's decision to release Astra despite these warnings. I also urged OpenAI to provide researchers from the National Institute of Standards and Technology, the National Security Agency, and the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency with full and transparent access to the technical information they need to assess the risks to our digital systems and critical infrastructure. If OpenAI or any AI developer cannot guarantee the safety of its models or effectively monitor their behavior, those models should be removed from public use. We need to pump the brakes until clear rules are in place to prevent this technology from doing grave harm. That includes mandatory safeguards and a comprehensive testing regime. If any AI developer fails to contain their technology during development or testing, they should be held accountable under our existing laws while Congress works to develop new commonsense guardrails. Instead, President Trump dismissed concerns about AI safety as a "hoax." He has said that he is the only guardrail that's needed while focusing his efforts on renaming AI to "Super Intelligence." After starting his presidency by delivering for the Silicon Valley investors and tech oligarchs who helped fund his return to the White House (remember, they were seated right behind him when he was sworn in) by eliminating safety rules and working to block both federal and state oversight, the Trump Administration has done little to protect public safety from this growing threat. Earlier this year, when the Trump Administration tried to force Anthropic to include dangerous capabilities in their contract, like the ability for AI to control autonomous weapons or to perform mass surveillance in the United States, I demanded the Administration end their pressure campaign - an alarming abuse of governmental power. Instead, the Administration doubled down and retaliated against Anthropic by designating them as a supply chain risk. A federal judge has since ruled in one case that the Administration's retaliatory actions were unlawful, but we must continue pushing back. Humans must always be in control, and no technology should enable mass surveillance in our free country. Because this is a digital technology, across the world may impact the American people. The United States currently has the most advanced models, but Chinese AI companies are also pushing the technology. When Trump welcomed China's President Xi to Washington, I led sixteen of my Senate colleagues in to discuss basic safety guardrails on the international development of advanced AI. President Trump delivered nothing but a tour of his ballroom for President Xi. Congress needs to act now. We must confront the political system that enabled the unregulated AI race while delivering what must be done today: strong federal guardrails on AI development to ensure public safety and security. Stopping Trump's Illegal and Senseless War in Iran, Ending U.S. Complicity in Gaza, and Demanding Accountability in the West Bank President Trump's illegal war in Iran continues to and civilians, drain our resources, and here at home. Estimates from the Pentagon show that the war has already cost American taxpayers $47 billion, while the Congressional Budget Office (CBO) estimates this war will cost another $2 billion to $3 billion for every additional month it continues. CBO also estimates that the United States has used between one-half and two-thirds of its inventory of certain missile defense interceptors since June 2025 - stockpiles needed in the event of a real national security threat that could take five years to rebuild. American families are paying for this war every day. Every two minutes, consumers pay another $1 million in higher fuel costs because of Trump's war. Across Maryland, drivers have spent an estimated $1 billion more at the gas pump since the war began - an average of $642 per family. President Trump calls those higher prices "peanuts" and a "very small price to pay." Families struggling to afford gas, groceries, and electricity know otherwise. This is what happens when you delude yourself into believing that one more week of airstrikes or one more month of a blockade will produce a quick victory. As I warned in July, this kind of logic is how forever wars begin. When you are digging yourself into a hole, stop digging. But Trump keeps digging. He is now reportedly sending up to another 10,000 troops to fight this illegal war of choice, which he says he plans to renew next month. Instead of working to end the war, protect our troops, save civilian lives across the region, and lower costs, the Trump Administration announced that it plans to send $2.8 billion in bombs - paid for by American taxpayers - to a government still led by someone wanted for war crimes, and even as Prime Minister Netanyahu continues dropping bombs in Gaza despite the so-called "ceasefire." Netanyahu has said outright that in Gaza they are "destroying more and more houses so the Palestinians will have nowhere to return." I will work to block this transfer of American taxpayer-financed bombs. I made clear that in the aftermath of the horrific Hamas attacks of October 7th, Israel was justified in going after Hamas, but not in imposing brutal collective punishment on all the people of Gaza. Meanwhile, the final outcome of this week's Israeli election remains uncertain. Coalition negotiations could take weeks, and Netanyahu will remain a caretaker Prime Minister until a new government is formed. Regardless of the outcome, the United States must judge any Israeli government and leader by the same standards and whether their actions comport with our interests and values. We must enforce our laws and ensure that American taxpayer dollars are not used to support the occupation or violations of Palestinian's human rights, regardless of who is in power in Israel. That's why we are also demanding answers about the unacceptable situation on the West Bank, where violent Israeli settlers terrorize Palestinians with impunity and seek to force them off their lands. Moreover, in just over four years, nine Americans have been killed in the West Bank, yet none of their families have received accountability or justice from either the Israeli or United States Governments. In addition to these deaths, Americans are routinely wrongfully imprisoned by the Netanyahu government, and Palestinians under the Israeli occupation of the West Bank. That is why Senators Kaine, Sanders, and I led 23 of our Senate colleagues in a resolution requiring the State Department to report to Congress on these killings, rampant violent settler attacks, and the dire human rights violations in the West Bank, including the detention of American citizens and Palestinian children. and urged my colleagues to support because the families of those killed and detained deserve answers. The American people deserve answers. And we must ensure that recipients of U.S. taxpayer dollars are acting in accordance with our laws and our values. While I was pleased that 47 Senators supported this effort - more support than we've ever had in this fight - it's clear the United States must do more. I will keep fighting to end U.S. complicity in Gaza, demand accountability for in the West Bank, stand up for human rights for all, and stop President Trump's illegal war in Iran. Delivering for Maryland Despite the dysfunction and chaos generated by the Trump Administration, I remain focused on delivering real results for communities across Maryland. In Baltimore, Senator Alsobrooks and I recently highlighted a $300,000 investment we secured for to expand their workforce development and career counseling services for refugees and immigrants. This federal funding will help program participants obtain the skills and training needed to secure jobs, achieve rapid self-sufficiency so they can contribute even more to their communities, and create opportunities for economic growth. Just one week before this event, the Trump Administration had announced it would be illegally rescinding over $800 million in federal funds approved by Congress for programs that have supported many Marylanders, including Global Refuge. I will continue to fight back against the Trump Administration's unlawful acts and work hard to ensure that these vital programs are appropriately funded. While in Baltimore, I also joined Congressman Mfume and Mayor Scott at the Baltimore City Office of Equity and Civil Rights' 33rd Annual Civil Rights Breakfast to honor Maryland's trailblazing civil rights leaders - past and present - and to discuss efforts to fight back against this Administration's attempts to dismantle their work. In Baltimore County, Congressman Olszewski and I joined local leaders to celebrate a $2 million federal investment that will support the construction of a new Baltimore County Public Library branch. The new Essex Branch will give the library more room for programs and community use, while allowing it to offer services that cannot be adequately accommodated in the current branch. Every Marylander should have access to all the books and resources that libraries have to offer, regardless of their ZIP code or their income. And this week in Howard County, I joined County Executive Calvin Ball and Enterprise Community Development - a national nonprofit focused on expanding access to affordable housing, founded and based in Columbia - to mark the grand opening of The Vision at Parkway. Together with former Congressman Sarbanes, we secured an $850,000 federal investment for the project. The project also received $13 million in federal tax credits and other HUD loans. The opening of The Vision at Parkway will expand housing options in Columbia and provide more Marylanders with an affordable place to call home. We're also bringing Maryland leaders and community partners together in Washington to advance our shared priorities. The Maryland congressional delegation recently met with at the Capitol to discuss our work to expand affordable housing, improve Baltimore's transportation and infrastructure, continue to strengthen public safety, and protect access to health care. As the Trump Administration targets essential programs that Baltimore residents rely on, Federal Team Maryland will continue working alongside our state and local partners to defend those resources and deliver new investments in the City's future. The Maryland congressional delegation also met recently with leadership and stakeholders to discuss the Port's infrastructure needs, upcoming modernization projects, workforce, and long-term growth. With more than 270,000 Maryland jobs connected to the Port and $70 billion in annual economic impact for our state, its continued success is a priority for all of us. Together, we're working to build on past investments and secure the resources needed to strengthen the Port and expand economic opportunity across Maryland. Thank You The decisions being made in Washington have real consequences for Marylanders, from the prices families pay to the use of taxpayer dollars at home and abroad. I will continue bringing Marylanders' priorities into every fight ahead. Thank you for staying engaged and for all you do to strengthen our communities and our democracy! Don't forget to vote! Onwards, Chris Van Hollen To see more on my daily efforts to fight back against the Trump Administration, follow me on: , , , , , and . |

Folks,
I'm sorry to be so blunt, but after Vice President Vance came back to North Carolina yet again for another MAGA rally yesterday, I have to ask:
**[Will you chip in $5 to help me fight back and flip this seat?](https://substack.com/redirect/ea9b0f58-0b5b-4639-9d49-b19bfbc59bdf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Let me explain why your support is so important - and what could happen without it.
1\. Trump was here last month. Then just last week, he and JD Vance came to NC again to rally alongside my MAGA opponent, Michael Whatley, and rile up the GOP base right before the election. And yesterday, Vance came back _again_ to do exactly the same thing.
2\. North Carolinians are already voting. If we don't have the resources to fight back against Trump and the GOP's oncoming wave of attacks, their lies and distortions could be the last thing people hear before heading to the polls.
3\. My team and I set a $5 million end-of-month goal to fight back, and I need your help to reach it.**** Falling short would mean putting our chances of flipping this seat at risk - so we simply cannot let that happen.
**Thousands of grassroots supporters are chipping in today to fuel this movement. Now, I 'm asking you to join them. [Will you give $5 or whatever you can today to help us reach our crucial $5 million goal, win in North Carolina and take back the Senate?](https://substack.com/redirect/ea9b0f58-0b5b-4639-9d49-b19bfbc59bdf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/ea9b0f58-0b5b-4639-9d49-b19bfbc59bdf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The amount you give doesn't matter nearly as much as your contribution itself. When lots and lots of people are pitching in, it adds up fast.
Thank you,
Roy

name: Public Citizen
subject: Major update on lawsuit to stop Trump's vanity arch
body:
We have a major update on our lawsuit to stop Donald Trump’s vanity arch.

* As you probably know, Trump wants to erect a huge arch in Washington, D.C. — just outside the hallowed grounds of Arlington National Cemetery, across from the Lincoln Memorial — to glorify himself.

* Earlier this year, Public Citizen — representing Vietnam War veterans and others — filed a lawsuit in federal court to stop construction of the arch.

* To be very clear, starting construction would be patently illegal. Building a monument like this requires approval from Congress, and Congress has not authorized it.

* Nevertheless, on October 21, the Trump regime indicated that it might begin construction _as soon as next week_.

* The very next day, October 22, we filed a motion for a preliminary injunction asking the court to stop construction from starting while our case goes forward.

* We asked the court to rule on our motion by November 4.

* Meanwhile, we are gearing up to respond if construction begins in violation of the law or contrary to the court’s orders.

**This is just one of the 54 lawsuits (and counting) that Public Citizen has filed against the administration since Donald Trump returned to power.**

**[If you can, please donate today to support Public Citizen as we continue standing up to the Trump regime.](https://act.citizen.org/s/6223156/NZS5npOd)**

**[Anything you can chip in — $5 or $25, $50 or $100, $500 or even more — will make a difference right now.](https://act.citizen.org/s/6223157/NZS5npOd)**

**[CONTRIBUTE NOW](https://act.citizen.org/s/6223158/NZS5npOd)**
**[Or join our popular Monthly Giving program (if you haven’t already) to help make sure we have the ongoing financial resources to fight Trump day after day after day.](https://act.citizen.org/s/6223159/NZS5npOd)**

If you’ve donated to Public Citizen before, thank you. If a donation is not right, we understand. Either way, thank you for being part of Public Citizen.

For justice,

\- Lisa Gilbert & Robert Weissman, Co-Presidents of Public Citizen

subject: Please help Angie - Bernie

Sisters and Brothers -
The stakes of this election are incredibly high. We’ve got to do everything we can to win in these final days.
Donald Trump is the most dangerous president in the history of the United States. He does not believe in the Constitution or the rule of law. He is a pathological liar, he is a narcissist, and he is running the most corrupt administration in American history. His policies are making the richest people in our country even richer while causing intense suffering for working families.
And if you believe that Donald Trump and his policies are a danger to the United States and the working families of our country, then we cannot allow the U.S. Senate to remain under Republican control and continue as a rubber stamp for Trump and all that he stands for.
That is just one of the reasons we must do all we can to elect Angie Nixon to the United States Senate. If she wins, Democrats are certain to take back the chamber.
If you agree and understand that Angie needs our help in this moment, please use this link to make a contribution directly to her campaign:
**[https://act.berniesanders.com/go/contribute-please](https://act.alexvindman.com/go/1786?refcode=em261029-av&t=1&akid=1183%2E3892029%2E3UWJHc)**
But this campaign is about more than just defeating Donald Trump.
In my view, Angie is absolutely right on the most important issues facing our country.
Angie knows that too many workers in Florida and around the country are trying to survive on starvation wages. She will work to raise the minimum wage to a living wage and make it easier for workers to join unions.
At a time of massive income and wealth inequality, Angie will fight to make sure that the billionaires in our country pay their fair share of taxes so that we can protect the needs of low income low-income and working families.
Angie will fight to end a corrupt campaign finance system which undermines American democracy and allows the very rich and their super PACs to buy and sell politicians. No. Elon Musk, the richest man on earth, should not be allowed to spend $290 million to help elect Trump president in 2024, and hundreds of millions more in this mid-term election to try and maintain Republican control of Congress.
Angie, like me, has the “radical” idea that democracy means one person, one vote - not the very rich controlling our political process.
Needless to say, I am doing all I can to help Angie, but I cannot do it alone.
Not me. Us.

THE BREWERS ARE WORLD SERIES CHAMPIONS!_** Sorry to come in hot, Derek, but we’re really excited. **For the first time in history, the Milwaukee Brewers have won the World Series!** And with just 5 days left until the election, Wisconsinites have the chance to make history again by electing David Crowley to become our state’s first Black governor. **In 2023, David Crowley led the bipartisan deal that kept the Brewers in Milwaukee! He protected our city’s team from being sold to the highest bidder, because he knows what matters to Wisconsin: our economy, our farms, our communities, and our sports!** And now, he’s fighting once again to keep MAGA billionaires from buying this election. I’ll be honest: I’ve always been a glass-half-full kind of person.

In times like these, I know it’s difficult to stay optimistic — or even
hopeful — about our country’s future. But I am. And I hope you are too.

But Derek, I want
to be clear: That optimism doesn’t make me naive. I know the stakes are
high. I know nothing is set in stone. And I know that a far-right Governor
could reverse all the progress we’ve made together.

chip in $10 right away to
help us reach our End-of-Month fundraising goal, expand our final voter
outreach programs, and keep the far-right out of power here in
battleground Pennsylvania?

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/21924?t=1002&akid=856%2E245147%2EE4FpoM ]Donate →

With only five days until Election Day, I’m feeling
optimistic,
Derek. But that doesn’t mean we
can sit back and watch from the sidelines. The far-right has all the same
information we have — and we know they won’t take their ball and go home.

We have to stay ready. We have to stay vigilant. We have to stay prepared.
And Derek, we
can only do that with your help.

Thank you,

Josh

In 1758, George Washington ran for the House of Burgesses and discovered the founding price of a vote: roughly half a gallon of alcohol per voter. One hundred and sixty gallons of rum punch, wine, and cider, dispensed to 391 loyal constituents. The Father of His Country was also the Father of the Open Bar.
The system matured. Tammany Hall perfected it -- election-day roast chickens, baskets of coal, and a saloon stool with your name on it. New York law required bars to close on election day, which was itself the bribe: a politician who kept the tap running was a politician who understood his market. By 1888 the rate had been standardized in Indiana as "blocks of five" -- a few dollars a head, cash on delivery, for the floaters. And the last documented street price in America was $20 a vote in Lincoln County, West Virginia, in 2010, plus beer and cigarettes. That election was voided, which tells you everything about how bribery works: the crime isn't buying the vote. The crime is buying it at a price a judge finds believable.

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
October 27, 2026 **CONTACT**
Allison Abney media@emergeamerica.org
**Emerge Announces Record Number of Women on the Ballot in Midterm Elections** _Emerge's historic slate represents a more than 25% increase in candidates since the landmark 2018 “Year of the Woman” midterm elections_

**WASHINGTON, D.C.** — With just one week until the November 3 midterm elections, Emerge, the nation's largest network of women elected officials and candidates, announced today that **more than 700 Emerge women are on the ballot across the country, the highest number in the organization's history.**

Women are running in record numbers for governor, Congress, and state legislatures this year, with Emerge helping drive that historic surge.

Among the Emerge women on the ballot are more than **330 candidates running for state legislatures across 28 states, more than 300 candidates running for local office, 33 candidates running for the U.S. House of Representatives, one candidate running for the U.S. Senate, and 22 candidates running for statewide offices.**

"Anyone who thinks women have stopped stepping up to run for office should look at our numbers," **said A'shanti F. Gholar, President and CEO of Emerge.** "Women across the country know what's at stake for their families, their communities, and our democracy, and they're answering the call to lead. The level of interest we're seeing is extraordinary, and this historic slate of candidates shows what happens when we invest in women and give them the tools to succeed. These women are ready to win in November, help Democrats take back Congress, and build lasting political power at every level of government."

Emerge currently has 14 women serving in Congress, and its alums are playing a critical role in the fight for control of the U.S. House. Among them are two DCCC Frontline incumbents, Reps. **Emilia Sykes (OH-13)** and **Janelle Bynum (OR-05)** , who are defending must-protect Democratic seats. Will you stand with me?| | | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142459783/656997589/-1645665386?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDMyMDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTQ5YjBkOTYtYmZkMy1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAyMjQ4MjRkNGRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Zn8Sq6n-fSgHL4MyQd-HvTHSiV_mWB0AW-a4eb4tjuw=&emci=e39b0d96-bfd3-f111-bf5b-00224824d4db&emdi=e49b0d96-bfd3-f111-bf5b-00224824d4db&ceid=9848080)

Peter, Our economy should work for working people—not just billionaires. That's why I'm backing California's Proposition 40: a one-time 5% tax on billionaire wealth to help protect health care amid devastating federal cuts. As [_The New York Times_ reports,](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142459784/656997590/-1032515063?unlocked_article_code=1.LlE.8J3n.W68vbR7dHzB4&smid=url-share&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDMyMDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTQ5YjBkOTYtYmZkMy1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAyMjQ4MjRkNGRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Zn8Sq6n-fSgHL4MyQd-HvTHSiV_mWB0AW-a4eb4tjuw=&emci=e39b0d96-bfd3-f111-bf5b-00224824d4db&emdi=e49b0d96-bfd3-f111-bf5b-00224824d4db&ceid=9848080) if Prop 40 passes, California will make world history.

A one-time contribution would be a drop in the bucket for them, but could make a real difference for millions of working families struggling to get by. [**Sign if you agree: It’s time for billionaires to pay their fair share.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142459786/656997592/-1913272460?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDMyMDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTQ5YjBkOTYtYmZkMy1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAyMjQ4MjRkNGRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Zn8Sq6n-fSgHL4MyQd-HvTHSiV_mWB0AW-a4eb4tjuw=&emci=e39b0d96-bfd3-f111-bf5b-00224824d4db&emdi=e49b0d96-bfd3-f111-bf5b-00224824d4db&ceid=9848080)

I believe those who have benefited most from our economy have a responsibility to give something back. **That’s why I’ve teamed up with Senator Bernie Sanders to introduce a federal 5% billionaire tax** , which would raise an estimated $4.4 trillion by requiring the wealthiest Americans to finally pay their fair share. That revenue would be used to:
* Expand Medicare to cover dental, vision, and hearing
* Strengthen and extend healthcare access
* Provide a $3,000 check to every American earning under $150,000
* Guarantee a $60,000 minimum salary for every public school teacher.

A tax system where billionaires pay lower effective tax rates than teachers, nurses, and firefighters is broken, plain and simple. We can build an economy that rewards hard work and invests in people—not one that keeps putting billionaires first. **[ADD YOUR NAME: Support taxing billionaires and trillionaires so we can have an economy that works for everyone.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142459788/656997594/-1913272460?contactdata=RD9xu55pq9F46Vlqr3tWvuSptpuYyUMfsSFt7LIcDgChDKhCkh9eD0AXheKGhAi19RuqxUvx67WWbmn0HNk2qBA5PdHVSTa1CsO+P7ZhOD+71L1oCIWs6n2+0gJkNP9v2MdEIWWifDjhkwnv8H6y49GsGcOf1Tj3idKqnHHyoWS+IVOAHJ6+R1GUsywlIZzB&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDMyMDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTQ5YjBkOTYtYmZkMy1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAyMjQ4MjRkNGRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Zn8Sq6n-fSgHL4MyQd-HvTHSiV_mWB0AW-a4eb4tjuw=&emci=e39b0d96-bfd3-f111-bf5b-00224824d4db&emdi=e49b0d96-bfd3-f111-bf5b-00224824d4db&ceid=9848080) **

clean_body: I'm taking on the billionaire class. Will you stand with me?| | | | Peter, Our economy should work for working people—not just billionaires. That's why I'm backing California's Proposition 40: a one-time 5% tax on billionaire wealth to help protect health care amid devastating federal cuts. As if Prop 40 passes, California will make world history. People are tired of politicians making excuses for the billionaire class. This is a modest ask of people with extraordinary wealth. A one-time contribution would be a drop in the bucket for them, but could make a real difference for millions of working families struggling to get by. I believe those who have benefited most from our economy have a responsibility to give something back. That’s why I’ve teamed up with Senator Bernie Sanders to introduce a federal 5% billionaire tax , which would raise an estimated $4.4 trillion by requiring the wealthiest Americans to finally pay their fair share. That revenue would be used to: Expand Medicare to cover dental, vision, and hearing Strengthen and extend healthcare access Provide a $3,000 check to every American earning under $150,000 Guarantee a $60,000 minimum salary for every public school teacher. A tax system where billionaires pay lower effective tax rates than teachers, nurses, and firefighters is broken, plain and simple. We can build an economy that rewards hard work and invests in people—not one that keeps putting billionaires first. Thank you for your activism and all you do. Onward,Ro | | | | | | | Wait! # [Alphabet plunges after first double miss in years as AI burns cash](https://substack.com/redirect/34b15848-fc55-42f2-9cdb-21d1229c1d40?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Alphabet **[posted its first top- and bottom-line miss](https://substack.com/redirect/7d8eec1d-19cd-46c8-9277-eb4070ae2571?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in nearly four years, sending shares down more **[than 10% as free cash flow](https://substack.com/redirect/6bad24c5-90df-40d4-8027-aeaa13a9fb32?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** turned sharply negative on heavy AI spending while search advertising slowed.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/34b15848-fc55-42f2-9cdb-21d1229c1d40?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Search growth slows:** Revenue from search and other advertising rose 12% but missed estimates as **[AI chat tools took a larger bite out of the core ad business.](https://substack.com/redirect/6e4401fd-a861-4330-bb5e-43e5b823437b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
* **Cash flow turns red:** Free cash flow hit negative $9.07 billion against expectations of a positive result near $2.70 billion.
* **Capex stays elevated:** Third-quarter capital spending reached roughly $51.4 billion; 2026 guidance was held at $195-205 billion with a significant increase expected in 2027.
* **Cloud still surges:** Google Cloud revenue more than doubled, up 103%, remaining the one clear bright spot that beat expectations.

# [Fed holds rates steady in 10-2 vote days before midterms](https://substack.com/redirect/34b15848-fc55-42f2-9cdb-21d1229c1d40?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The Federal Reserve held its benchmark rate at **[3.75%-4% in a 10-2 decision,](https://substack.com/redirect/a681ff3b-0f24-4e45-8d29-42d1aa8bce81?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/a681ff3b-0f24-4e45-8d29-42d1aa8bce81?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)with two officials **[dissenting in favor of a hike](https://substack.com/redirect/19228515-5277-4c68-bb3d-ffb1145a98aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as Chair Warsh stressed the need for more data before the midterms.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/34b15848-fc55-42f2-9cdb-21d1229c1d40?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Two officials dissent:** **[Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack](https://substack.com/redirect/0378c778-6d18-4332-87d0-fc0eb31baed0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** both voted for a quarter-point increase, Cook's first dissent since joining in 2022.
* **Inflation remains elevated:** The statement said inflation remains elevated and the committee will wait for the accumulation of more information before acting again.
* **Fewer meetings ahead:** Warsh said one 2027 meeting will focus only on strategy with no rate vote, and two meetings in 2028 will be strategy-only.
* **December hike still priced:** Traders continued to price a high probability of another increase in December despite the pause.

**Honoring Labor and Civil Rights Leader Dolores Huerta** Our nation and movement lost a courageous, powerful voice for justice yesterday.. | Hi Peter, it's Stef, Claire's campaign manager. I wanted to reach out before the weekend because we're coming up on our last big fundraising deadline before Election Day.
On Tuesday, New Yorkers will vote to send Claire to Congress, and even if you don't live in New York, what happens in this race matters.
Claire knows firsthand what a strong union can do for a working person's life. Her union gave her something too many workers are denied: control over her own time and a say in the conditions of her work.
Now she's running for Congress to fight for those same rights for everyone. The right to organize a union without fear of retaliation, health care that doesn't disappear when you lose your job, and an economy where all of us have real power over the decisions that shape our lives.
We're just days away from seeing a union organizer who refuses corporate PAC money winning a seat in Congress, and we have one last fundraising deadline to get through.
Saturday at midnight is our final fundraising deadline before Election Day. Every dollar we raise between now and then goes straight into our last push to reach voters, knock doors, and make sure Claire's supporters turn out on Tuesday to support the entire democratic socialist ticket.

clean_body: I just left South Carolina. This race is neck and neck, and Darline needs us now. | Fellow Patriot, On Monday, I was in South Carolina, on the campaign trail with Darline Graham. I want to tell you what I saw, because this race is closer than anyone in Washington wants to admit. It is neck and neck. Election Day is less than a week away, and Darline's seat could swing either way. Here's what I told the folks there: -> You don't want a Senate run by Chuck Schumer. -> You don't want Elizabeth Warren to chair the Senate Banking Committee. -> And you don't want Bernie Sanders setting environmental policy that kills jobs in South Carolina. That's the radical Democrat agenda, and it's what Annie Andrews would be voting for. She's raised over $25 million - nearly $4 million in the last couple of weeks - from liberal donors who don't share South Carolina's values. She built her campaign attacking Lindsey, and now her whole mission is to defeat his sister. Darline stands for common sense: low taxes, good jobs, and backing the police. She won't vote to put violent criminals back on the street or to let boys compete in girls' sports. She has thirty years of experience working for the people of her state, and she has a backbone. What Darline doesn't have is Hollywood money. Schumer needs JUST FOUR SEATS to take the majority, and he's betting South Carolina hands him one because Darline is being outspent after running two elections back-to-back. Fellow Patriot, races this close are decided in the final days by who can stay on the air, keep volunteers knocking doors, and get voters to the polls. They tried this playbook on me in Texas. National Democrats dumped millions to attack me because they thought the bigger bank account would win. Now I'm making a personal plea: show up for Darline. | | | | | | We have less than a week. name: Dr. Shirley Weber
subject: Remembering Dolores Huerta
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Shirley Weber for Secretary of State 2026
body:
https://drshirleyweber.com/?utm_source=email%20wrapper&utm_medium=email%20wrapper&utm_campaign=email%20wrapper [https://drshirleyweber.com/?utm_source=email%20wrapper&utm_medium=email%20wrapper&utm_campaign=email%20wrapper]
Friends,

Yesterday, we lost Dolores Huerta. She passed away at home, surrounded by family. She was 96.

Dolores was a labor leader, a feminist, and a civic rights icon. She was also my friend.

Dolores taught countless Californians to demand the respect that we all innately deserve. She did so in times and places when women were not always welcome: on the picket line, in union board meetings, and in cities across California.

Her creativity and keen organizing ability helped catapult the United Farm Workers to national prominence. Her leadership in the national grape boycott brought the fight for farmworker dignity to discussions at dinner tables across the country.

In Sacramento, she played a pivotal role in passing the Agricultural Labor Relations Act of 1975, and in winning disability insurance for farmworkers.

Dolores understood that power ran through the ballot box. In 1968, she registered Mexican-American voters across California for Robert Kennedy's presidential campaign, and celebrated with him when he won the California primary the night he was assassinated.

Despite reaching the age of 96, she never slowed down when it came to engaging on the issues that mattered. In 2019, she was arrested at a Fresno County Board of Supervisors meeting protesting for a raise for home care workers.

Throughout her life, she remained politically engaged, often endorsing key ballot measures that would improve the lives of women, children, farmworkers, and all Californians.

I feel incredibly lucky to have known her; we are all lucky to live in a state that has been shaped by Dolores's fearless advocacy.

Our midterm election is only a few days away. I can think of no greater way to honor Delores's memory than making sure to return your ballot [https://www.sos.ca.gov/elections/make-plan-vote/] . Make a plan » [https://www.sos.ca.gov/elections/make-plan-vote/] In solidarity,

Dr. Shirley N. Weber

California Secretary of State

The Swing Left community will contact voters in swing districts and states across the country this weekend.
#
Hi there,
**It’s hard to believe there are just five days left until Election Day— _and one final weekend to get out the vote!_**
The Swing Left community will be working to contact voters in swing districts and states all over the country this weekend. We’ll be holding in-person canvasses and virtual phone banks, and **this is your last chance to join one of these shifts** and have as many conversations with voters as possible. Because none of us wants to wake up the day after the election thinking: _I wish I’d done more._
[](https://act.swingleft.org/go/3230?t=1&akid=3329%2E1562180%2EbFr5UN)
[**Will you use the Take Action Tool to find the best volunteer opportunity for you and sign up for a shift this weekend?**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/3230?t=2&akid=3329%2E1562180%2EbFr5UN)
Connecting directly with voters is the single most effective way to help Democrats win the most competitive races in swing districts and states across the country.
Whether you’re an experienced volunteer or this is your first time, there’s a place for you at a Ground Truth canvass or phone bank. We’ll make sure you have everything you need to be successful!
Flipping the House, winning the Senate, and building Democratic governing power in the states is within our reach—but only if we all do our part while there’s still time left.
Thank you, as always, for everything you do. We hope to see you out there this weekend!
— The Swing Left Team

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. Education vs. Woke Indoctrination.

Second Amendment vs. Gun Grabbers.

You vs. Big Government.

Second Amendment vs. Gun Grabbers. You vs. Big Government. Peter, every one of these fights runs through one state. Arizona is the front line for the future of our nation. Turning Point calls Arizona home. We know this ground better than anyone, and we know how close it is. By the numbers, Arizona is the most important swing state in America. Arizona carries 11 electoral votes today and is on track to gain a 12th. Without Arizona, nearly 70% of the statistical paths to the presidency disappear. That's why 2026 matters so much. This election sets the table for 2028. Whoever wins the White House in 2028 will be in charge of the 2030 census, and the census shapes the redistricting that follows. Win Arizona now, and we win nationally for a generation. Lose it, and we could lose the country for just as long. But here's the issue . . . Turning Point PAC AZ is supporting ballot chasers across the state. They 're trained and ready to work every day until the polls close. But we need to secure additional funding to keep them in the field. With only days left, every day they aren't funded is a day of votes we can't get back. That's one patriot knocking doors and chasing ballots in the state that decides the future of our country. Will you stand with us today and support a ballot chaser in Arizona? Charlie built this movement to win fights like this one. Now it's on us to finish the job. For America and for Charlie, Turning Point PAC Arizona Paid for by Turning Point PAC Arizona. body:

---
Friend,What a beautiful morning in Wisconsin.

Last night, the Milwaukee Brewers won the World Series, the first championship in the team’s 57-year history. Whether you stayed up for the final out or woke up to the news this morning, I hope you’re smiling as wide as I am.

**The Brewers are an incredible gift to the city of Milwaukee and to our state as a whole.** Keeping professional sports teams in Wisconsin means so much to those of us who live here. They give us a reason to gather, a shared sense of identity, and, in very special moments like last night, a reason to celebrate together.

I’m grateful for this exceptional team of champions who brought us all so much joy this season. Plenty of people counted them out. They kept showing up anyway, and they won together.

That spirit is on my mind this morning, with Election Day just five days away. Our field team and volunteers are out across the 7th District right now, knocking doors and having real conversations with our neighbors. It’s the work that wins close races, and this is the week it matters most.

However you’re celebrating today, thank you for being part of this team.

Go Brewers,
Fred

| | | Dear Peter,
---
The first rains of the season are beginning to soak Northern California’s redwood forests, and nature lovers are lacing up their hiking boots. It’s lichen-spotting time. Stormy weather can send tree branches tumbling to the forest floor, giving us a rare close-up look at lichens that normally live high overhead in the redwood canopy. Look among the fallen branches and you might spot leafy green lichens that resemble lettuce, or tangles of yellow and orange that look like bits of tropical coral. If you haven’t caught lichen fever yourself, you might after reading [**our** **recent story**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/142461918/657004417/-525460627?utm_campaign=storysend&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ea-news-all&sourceid=1171055&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI5YTRhMzlhLWMzZDMtZjExMS1iZjViLTAwMjI0ODI0ZDRkYiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=YmLVZ35ty-DLXLjM7NEITO-KEvLi45DrkCuEDmXOBa0=&emci=2763bf20-03d3-f111-bf5b-00224824d4db&emdi=b9a4a39a-c3d3-f111-bf5b-00224824d4db&ceid=1504551)**** by Alex Bippus, resident lichen expert at Save the Redwoods League. Alex, our Public Grants Officer, has a PhD in botany and, to put it mildly, a thing for lichens. He takes us into their tiny, surprisingly colorful world and reveals just how important they are for the redwood forest.
---
---
Alex's story may turn you into a lichenophile too. These tiny organisms do surprisingly big things, from bringing nutrients into the forest to helping create soil high in the canopy, where ferns, shrubs, and even other trees can grow. So, after the next storm passes, look down. Who knows what strange little piece of the redwood forest might have landed at your feet.

clean_body: Fall weather brings some amazing things down from the redwood canopy| | | | | | | | | | Dear Peter, The first rains of the season are beginning to soak Northern California’s redwood forests, and nature lovers are lacing up their hiking boots. It’s lichen-spotting time. Stormy weather can send tree branches tumbling to the forest floor, giving us a rare close-up look at lichens that normally live high overhead in the redwood canopy. Look among the fallen branches and you might spot leafy green lichens that resemble lettuce, or tangles of yellow and orange that look like bits of tropical coral. If you haven’t caught lichen fever yourself, you might after reading **** by Alex Bippus, resident lichen expert at Save the Redwoods League. Alex, our Public Grants Officer, has a PhD in botany and, to put it mildly, a thing for lichens. He takes us into their tiny, surprisingly colorful world and reveals just how important they are for the redwood forest. Alex's story may turn you into a lichenophile too. These tiny organisms do surprisingly big things, from bringing nutrients into the forest to helping create soil high in the canopy, where ferns, shrubs, and even other trees can grow. So, after the next storm passes, look down. Who knows what strange little piece of the redwood forest might have landed at your feet. | | Happy spotting, Save the Redwoods League Photos from top: Anthony Speca; Courtesy of Alex Bippus | | | Save the Redwoods League220 Montgomery Street, Suite 350 San Francisco, CA 94104 CONNECT WITH US | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- |

name: Chad Bianco
subject: Stand With Your Deputies
body:
Call and email all five Supervisors now

| STOP DEFUNDING OUR DEPUTIES $125 million shortfall · Over 600 fewer deputies at risk
---
| |

**A MESSAGE FROM SHERIFF CHAD BIANCO.**

Friends,
The Board of Supervisors’ ad hoc committee is seeking public feedback on creating a new “oversight” committee for the Sheriff’s Department.

**I have serious concerns about this proposal and the political motivations behind it.** Some of the same activists advocating for this committee recently pressured the Board to defund our Sheriff’s Department by **$125 million, threatening more than 600 deputy positions.**
**We already have federal, state, and local oversight.** This committee won’t make you safer. It’s a waste of tax dollars and more political lawfare from Sacramento’s playbook.
---
| | | | | BE RESPECTFUL. BE ASSERTIVE.
MAKE YOUR VOICE HEARD.
---
| |

**Riverside County residents — get vocal today.** Call your Supervisor. Email your Supervisor. Tell them you oppose this committee. Flood the phone lines. Fill their inboxes. Be nice. Be respectful. And be assertive. **While you don’t get a vote on this, you still have influence.**

Every time a new agency, department, or committee is proposed to the public, it sounds like a great idea. But in the end, it’s just another layer of bureaucracy **wasting your hard-earned money,** and most of the time, like in this case, it will be used for political control.
**Share this with your Facebook friends, neighbors, and family.** People need to know what the Board is doing. I cannot stress enough, how vital it is that the board hears from you and not just the activists who want fewer deputies on your streets.

The Idaho cheap labor lobby just said the quiet part out loud...
[Rick Naerebout](https://substack.com/redirect/5a751cd4-9db5-4547-b750-fc0c6cbb0285?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) runs the [Idaho Dairymen's Association](https://substack.com/redirect/f18c6f2e-3fee-4e2e-bf4b-32b35d65068d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). And the Washington State Dairy Federation.
In a [new article](https://substack.com/redirect/029dbc8e-fe65-471c-86bd-a9ec4b6ee97a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), he talks about how they beat you in the 2026 primaries:
_**" We've already lost our House to the far right."**_
Far right is what he calls the Idaho House for passing a bunch of immigration bills that never made it out of the Idaho Senate. So they spent around $200,000 on nine Republican primaries to protect what he calls the "firewall" of moderate senators.
Their guy won in 8 of those 9 races.
Then they bought billboards:
_" We could track when people were passing these billboards, then push a digital ad to those same people."_
They grabbed your phone's location when you drove by. Then they chased you onto social media. He said "it freaked our board out." Freaked me out too, Rick.
Then he bragged about their playbook:
_" Take out Idaho. Put in Kansas or Utah. Pick your red state. We don't care."_
It's true. They don't care about you.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bab1b012-ea3d-41d0-8a02-6e20d36ac82f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Back in February, the cheap labor lobby rolled out the "[Idaho Alliance for a Legal Workforce](https://substack.com/redirect/211859d1-74d2-435f-8fb7-9b5328402eab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" and sponsored an [economic study](https://substack.com/redirect/0092d50f-6d1e-4d6f-92c1-dc2741d19709?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with a [press conference](https://substack.com/redirect/ba04fb60-67ca-41b8-912d-e5126332a2f7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to try and scare the Legislature (didn't work).
The [Idaho Farm Bureau](https://substack.com/redirect/b5076dda-9dbf-491b-ae4c-89d8dea0f6b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) hosted it.
Their study admits nearly 90% of Idaho's dairy workforce is foreign-born. The source for that number is literally "According to the Idaho Dairymen's Association." And Naerebout [told NPR](https://substack.com/redirect/52f0aa48-ce90-41a7-8511-a73f6234f3bd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) last month that some 90% of the workers at Idaho's dairies may not have legal status.
_**That 's the cheap slave labor business model, in writing.**_
Then they quoted developer [Tommy Ahlquist](https://substack.com/redirect/ce06e90b-4ba0-424b-96dc-b0d8c1d52ee3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) saying we should "stay away from government red tape policies like e-verify." E-Verify is how you check that a worker is legal. And the ironic part is they named their group after the exact thing they're fighting against: a legal workforce.
Their "[fact sheet](https://substack.com/redirect/57c6fd87-073e-47d4-9549-38bedc28a832?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" says losing these workers would make the housing crisis worse. Page 2 of their study says Idaho's population boom "increased housing demand and led to sharply rising prices."
Yes, they wrote that.
Idaho's construction workforce nearly doubled from 2014 to 2024, and home prices went up 168% anyway, because every illegal worker they import needs a house too.
Plus, their study only looks at what happens right away, before anybody has time to fix anything.
And they admit they "assume price stability." That's economist-speak for: in our made-up model, prices never change. Including the price of labor.
Well, here in the real world, when a dairy can't find workers, it raises pay. Higher pay pulls Idahoans off the couch or out of worse jobs (or the dairy buys a machine that does the work of three guys).
But their "model" doesn't allow any of that. Wages are frozen. So the worker just vanishes and the job never gets filled. Rig it that way and the only answer you can ever get is more cheap foreign labor.
The scenario they ran was roughly 70% of Idaho's illegal workforce gone in a single year.
_**Show me the Idaho bill that does that. You can 't. So instead they built a scary hypothetical and waved it at the Legislature and the press as if any bill we pushed did that.**_
And they can't keep their own numbers straight anyway. Workers removed: 28,725 in the press release. 25,611 on page 34. 26,824 on page 37. Page 34 also says "total job losses of 1.16 million."
That's every job in Idaho!
And the authors' contact email is a gmail account (just saying.)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/753a64ce-7f13-4a77-8697-9c7328bf1a25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
My favorite line is on page 20 though.
States less dependent on illegal labor "will likely benefit," because companies will expand there. They name Wisconsin and Maine. So their own economists think leaning on illegal labor is a weakness?
Naerebout told NPR the jobs "just don't appeal to Americans."
No kidding.
What American wants to show up to a crew where nobody speaks his language, in lousy conditions, for pay built around workers who can't complain?
Of course it doesn't appeal to Americans. They built it that way.
And notice nobody in that crowd ever finishes the sentence with a wage. Cheap labor jobs only appeal to people with no other options.
That's the whole point.
Their own economists admit the fix exists. Page iv says that over the long run "adjustments and investments in other market segments, as well as substitutions for other activities, will be necessary." Page 20 says "Investments in capital are likely to be made."
That's higher pay. That's the robot milker. That's hiring the kid down the road. But they cut every bit of it out of the model, because a study where Idaho adapts can't sell amnesty (their goal).
Pay Idahoans. Buy the equipment. Enforce the law so the dairyman who does it right isn't undercut by the one who doesn't.
Idaho first.
All of it points at their [SAWA](https://substack.com/redirect/02d95004-7a88-4eb2-92b7-dad8ab55e118?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) amnesty bill.
It turns guest workers into [350-day "temporary" workers](https://substack.com/redirect/a19a8640-808a-47d5-a6bd-dd80ff4075aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and gives [legal status to illegals](https://substack.com/redirect/a5c16468-ff8d-4284-afce-c480587de82f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) who were here by May 31, 2026 and worked in ag. It caps their wage growth around 3.25% a year and folds meatpacking into "agriculture."
I thought 1986 was supposed to be the last amnesty. (I was 7 years old, but still.)
So here's your homework. Go look up which nine races that $200,000 went into. Then ask your state senator, by name, which side of the firewall they're on.

Peter,

Less than a week from now San Francisco can send its first openly LGBTQ member to Congress. I want the people who made it happen to be part of it.

[Will you donate $3 now to ensure we can run a winning campaign in the final days before Election Day?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142462247/657005526/-1968648407?amount=3&refcode=SW_EM_FR_CORE_261029_2_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDY5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MGEyYjJhNi1jNGQzLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyNGQ0ZGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FSGRG_rCuKdk-B3MSQJ34DWc1ZRU6fUvoLsPNfl6RVY=)

Harvey Milk once said, “Hope will never be silent.”

I think about that a lot – with Trump coming after LGBTQ people, especially trans kids, every single week.

We have to keep showing up – in the streets, at the ballot box and in Congress.

This campaign was built by LGBTQ people and by allies who know that when one of us is targeted, all of us are. On election night, I’ll be thinking of every name on this list.

[Donate now to make history: Send me to Congress as San Francisco’s first openly LGBTQ member.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142462248/657005527/-1968648407?amount=5&refcode=SW_EM_FR_CORE_261029_2_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDY5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MGEyYjJhNi1jNGQzLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDIyNDgyNGQ0ZGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FSGRG_rCuKdk-B3MSQJ34DWc1ZRU6fUvoLsPNfl6RVY=)

Thank you,
Scott

On Monday, David Gallegos and I are hosting our Pre-Election Day Rally at the Rail Yards Market in Albuquerque. We’ll have mariachi music, good food, and a crowd of New Mexicans who are ready to bring leadership that works to Santa Fe.
**Monday, November 2
5:30 to 7:30 p.m.**
Rail Yards Market
777 1st St SW, Albuquerque
Mariachi Music & Food
This race comes down to who shows up. Monday night is our chance to thank the volunteers who have knocked doors for months, fire up the neighbors who are still deciding, and make sure every one of us has a plan to vote on Tuesday.
Bring your family. Bring a friend. And bring that neighbor who still hasn’t made up their mind.

[ stdin# ]Josh Shapiro for Pennsylvania
Derek,

I need to make a confession.

Yes, I want to win reelection so we can keep getting sh*t done for
Pennsylvania: Putting more money in folks’ pockets, growing our economy,
investing in our communities, protecting our freedoms, and giving every
Pennsylvanian a real shot at success.

But I also want to send a clear message: I want everyone to know — beyond
a shadow of a doubt — that here in Pennsylvania, we support reproductive
freedom. We support the union way of life. We support free, fair, safe,
and secure elections. And we reject Donald Trump’s chaos, cruelty, and
corruption.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/21818?t=1001&akid=857%2E245147%2E-rpqH1 ]But Derek, we
only have one opportunity to send that message, and we can’t drop the ball
— not when we’re this close to the finish line. TV ads, campaign events,
staff, rapid response, you name it — we need a well-funded campaign firing
on all cylinders to win next Tuesday. Now that you know: Will you chip in
any amount before our major fundraising deadline on Saturday?

October 29, 2026
Regular readers know that I am helping my good friend and fellow ophthalmologist Dr. Michael Goldstein in his quest to defeat entrenched incumbent Jim Himes.
But Mike's son Jon has also thrown is hat in the ring and is trying to oust incumbent Steve Meskers in the 150th Assembly district in Greenwich. Thus far, Jon has knocked on 4,000 doors and will continue to do so up to Election Day this Tuesday.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/502acc7b-975b-495b-aede-0d02e162e01a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Jon and Michael Goldstein with a Supporter
Mike recently debated Jim Himes and showcased his mastery of the issues, even on esoteric subjects such as sewage drainage into Long Island Sound, something that Jim Himes has done absolutely nothing about.

But was truly hilarious about the debate was Jim Himes doing what Democrats do best at election time - pretending to be a Republican. Himes said virtually nothing about the invasion of ten million illegals into the country allowed by the Biden administration until it became an issue in 2024. And when he stated that illegals were not receiving public assistance, Mike rattled off statistics (Mike has a great memory) proving Himes was full of baloney.

But the biggest point made during this debate was Himes plan of reducing the deficit -the increasing inheritance taxes.

Presently, assets are passed on to heirs at their present value. For example, if a father passes 1000 shares of Apple stock valued at $350 a share to his daughter, that stock becomes her property without tax. But what Congressman Himes wants to do is tax this daughter on the price the father paid for the stock (what is called the basis). So, if the father purchased the Apple at 50 twenty years ago, the daughter would have to pay a huge capital gains tax. This would apply to houses also.

If this position became known throughout Fairfield County, Jim Himes would be wearing a leaf blower after Election Day.
Mike has spent more than four decades practicing medicine and still does surgery. But he is also a lawyer and has been active in medical organizations and community affairs
Jonathan, 45, is also an attorney and construction consultant who grew up in Greenwich. His campaign for the state legislature is his first attempt at elected office.
And although both candidates concentrate on different issues, they enjoy campaigning together - knocking on doors, attending community events, meeting neighbors, and exchanging ideas.

Michael has emphasized healthcare reform, energy policy, and government accountability in his congressional campaign - national issues.

But Jon talks more about clean beaches, local infrastructure, sewage pollution, housing development, and the relationship between Greenwich and state government.
They do not agree on everything. But few people do - even father and son.
But whatever the results, the campaign has already provided the Goldstein family with an experience few parents and children share.

name: Alexander Hale for Congress
subject: Here's How We Beat Rep. Fletcher at the Finish Line
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexander Hale for Congress
body:
Days from Election Day, a small token could be what wins this.
| Hale for Texas TX-07
---

Friends, A couple of weeks ago I wrote to Caroline Kane's supporters, and you were on that list. This is Alex Hale again. I am running to beat Rep. Lizzie Fletcher, and the election is Tuesday, November 3. We are days from Election Day, and I need your help keeping our momentum up through the finish line. Here is the honest math. My opponent raised less than $200,000 in the third quarter. That's nothing for an incumbent, and it means the last week of this race is winnable on the ground. A gift of $100 right now goes straight into final-week voter contact: the doors, the texts, and the ads that reach the voters who decide close races. Enough of those gifts, and I get to blitz her in the end instead of coasting to the line. If $100 is more than you can do, $20 works too. A small token of gratitude from enough people is what gets us the win. Here is how you can help over the next week:
| **1\. Chip in for our final push.** $100 changes the map. $20 makes a real difference. | [Chip in now](https://us.list-manage.com/SoxZqj_R5y_?e=7b2a5a4471&c2id=7d5e18a492e499c6f9219c3626b2b3c2&m=hhx7_7TXt_MOALDpC2HG-u2ch21m5JLSwUCuQOtmW-uM1yVtT36B1bc0YJ_5)
---
**2\. Wear a shirt.** They're comfy, and every one gets a neighbor talking. | [Get a shirt](https://us.list-manage.com/ZOdJ3ony_Kh?e=7b2a5a4471&c2id=7d5e18a492e499c6f9219c3626b2b3c2&m=6NFAjCYZY-JAqLvRIrKevVgqZuJfIwyCMdMWVk8Wnxhe1P0vx2EgR1ZwfVce)
---
**3\. Vote early** at any location in your county, through Friday, October 30, if you have not already. | [Find a polling place](https://us.list-manage.com/12wiCgkGvPA?e=7b2a5a4471&c2id=7d5e18a492e499c6f9219c3626b2b3c2&m=yuzvxHQfqSAGoAfMg2-AaujhVP9v00nxAQRtOnPvxUA_dBntVgnYXZtMQtdc)
---
**4\. Bring three friends or family members** with you, or remind them with Fired Up to Vote. | [Remind a friend](https://us.list-manage.com/OIX1YPoVuil?e=7b2a5a4471&c2id=7d5e18a492e499c6f9219c3626b2b3c2&m=wDaOt-CP6oW3W84bFBtggKFR2XPpui8nuAcQn1KkLg2de1MXfOUYMSCYbm_2)
---
**5\. Follow @halefortexas** and share my videos when they go up.
Thank you for reading this, and for being engaged. Let's finish the job.
Gratefully, Alex Alexander Hale, Republican Nominee, TX-07
P.S. If this note landed in your Promotions or Spam folder, dragging it to your main inbox helps my next message reach you.

name: Nancy Mannion
subject: Nancy Mannion - Heading into Election Weekend!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Citizens for Nancy Mannion
body:
| | |
---
---
**It ‘Twas’ the Weekend Before the Election...**
’Twas the weekend before voting, and all through the town,Supporters knock on the doors, as the sun settles down.The signs in the yards and the billboards stand tall,Talk of Democrats echo through the bright leaves of fall.The ballots are printed and considered with care,In hopes that those elected will serve us all fair.Though weary, we rally and keep up our stride;Republican candidates have nowhere to hide!On greeters! On watchers! On poll workers there!Let ballots be marked with focus and care!As choices are pondered, hope always takes flight,And voting remains both our duty and right.As we call on our neighbors, beneath the stars bright:“Happy Election to all, and to all a good Election Night!”
---

**Thank You for Your Support This Week******
Thank you for the outpouring of support after this week’s attack ads and mailers. Your kindness means so much to me and reminds me how caring this community is.
The Republican Federal Committee of Pennsylvania launched an attack ad highlighting my 2016 bankruptcy. I shared the following statement on our campaign’s [Facebook page](https://matj3.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsDg0dq0ZHdOMtph7VT17J/mn55JBFN39my) and want to share it here, too:
“You may have seen a Republican attack ad about my 2016 bankruptcy, and I want you to hear the truth directly from me. After my divorce, I went from sharing a household to carrying a much larger share of the debt on my own. I did everything I could to keep up, but eventually I ran out of options and filed for bankruptcy. It was one of the hardest decisions I've ever made. Divorce can upend every part of your life, including your finances, and I know many Americans have faced that same painful reality. I wouldn't wish bankruptcy on anyone, but the experience made me stronger, more focused, and more compassionate toward constituents who are confronting difficult financial choices of their own.
Medical bills and job loss are leading reasons Americans file for bankruptcy. Major life changes - such as divorce or caring for a family member - can also increase expenses while reducing income.
To the Republican Federal Committee of PA: I may have been financially broke ten years ago, but you have proven you are morally bankrupt today, by both attacking me with this ad and including a 1-800 number to an adult chat line.”
---
---
_Illustration displayed with the post on the_[ _Campaign Facebook page_](https://matj3.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsE8LM2QxdjJX9tWVKRkpN/tdrL3YrSSQ_I)
The response has been overwhelming. Community members shared their own financial struggles and those of friends and family. Others offered compassion or thanked me for being transparent and taking responsibility for my decision.The Republican Federal Committee of PA did not anticipate this support or the negative coverage sparked by what I believe it intended as a clever attack. As I noted above, the ad includes a 1-800 number for an adult chat line. Although the Smucker campaign is distancing itself from the ad, tactics like these definitely undermine its party’s claim to “family values.” I’ll leave it there. You can read more about the ad at [LancasterOnline](https://matj3.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsEag4ErLzpEhPxLt9QUXR/cPdOrQGBTfIJ) or at The [York Daily Record](https://matj3.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsF30mRHkLv9rg1BGyPEFV/mXHL4aL0Ymx0).
\- Nancy
_If this attack angers you as much as it does us, feel free to call the Republican Committee of Lancaster County and demand that Congressman Smucker apologize: 717-392-4165_
---
|
### Our Last-Minute Campaign Request for Donations!
---
As mentioned in Nancy’s note above, Republican dollars are funding attack ads against her. This is our final campaign weekend to get the word out about how she can better serve us in Congress, and we’re raising funds for more radio ads through Tuesday to reach as many voters as possible. Can you **[donate $5, $10 or $20](https://matj3.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsFVLUdi8i151w50enNxxZ/0QdAe4rCJaMG)**? Your contribution will go directly toward this weekend’s advertising budget. Thank you, as always, for your support.
---
**After You Vote, Join Us at the Election Night Watch Party – RSVP Here!**
Thank you to all the volunteers and supporters who have rallied around Nancy during this campaign. Let’s celebrate the community we’ve created and the movement we’ve only just begun. Join our Election Night Watch Party, from 7:00 – 11:00pm at Special Occasions in Columbia. Please RSVP to join us [here](https://matj3.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsFxgCq8X470CC8q2cMhfd/5PAWbcYjp3uL).
---
**Yes, we’re still knocking on doors!****Help Nancy win in the final weekend before Election Day!**

* **Knock Doors for Nancy and the Democratic Party Slate – Lancaster****(multiple days and shifts available)****.** More details [here](https://matj3.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsGQ0v2YvQCvMSCfQRLRNh/Aj0yKwhPh6Qe).

* **Don 't miss Governor Shapiro and Lieutenant Governor Davis AND Nancy at the Lancaster County Grassroots Rally Tomorrow, October 30, from 10:15am - 12:00pm.** The event will feature candidates up and down the ballot! Register [here](https://matj3.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsGsLdEzJmIqWiGUoGKB5l/lUMyT3LpYDqp) to receive the details.

* **Represent the Campaign at Lancaster Central Market, 23 North Market Street, Saturday October 31, 9:00am – 12:00pm.** Sign up [here](https://matj3.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsHKgLRPi8OlgyKKC5Iunp/o4wspuWGQHNL) to volunteer!

* **Be a Poll Greeter for Nancy and the ENTIRE Democratic Slate** – Sign up to greet voters and to represent Nancy and other Democrats outside of polling places across PA-11 on November 3. More details about the opportunity are [here](https://matj3.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsHn13dq6UUgrEO9ZuHeVt/Nd0BASka356a). You can sign up for online training to be a Poll Greeter [here](https://matj3.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfsZpYlGkSXJ032qSD3Et4z/p7_M-lSn_Pkw).

* **[Make a Donation](https://matj3.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfuSp5GZj1ll2PMecZY1d1V/17ud5fpNcT3j) **Let 's give Nancy the resources needed to finish this race strong. Your donation will help us reach every voter in PA-11**!**

Although the Smucker campaign is distancing itself from the ad, tactics like these definitely undermine its party’s claim to “family values.” I’ll leave it there. You can read more about the ad at or at The . \- Nancy If this attack angers you as much as it does us, feel free to call the Republican Committee of Lancaster County and demand that Congressman Smucker apologize: 717-392-4165 | Our Last-Minute Campaign Request for Donations! This is our final campaign weekend to get the word out about how she can better serve us in Congress, and we’re raising funds for more radio ads through Tuesday to reach as many voters as possible. Can you ? Your contribution will go directly toward this weekend’s advertising budget. Thank you, as always, for your support. After You Vote, Join Us at the Election Night Watch Party – RSVP Here! | | | Picture a voter who almost stays home. They voted in the last presidential election. They don’t love Donald Trump. But midterms never feel as big, they’re working two jobs, and nobody has asked them to vote this year. If nothing changes, they’ll sit this one out. **_Multiply that example by millions, and you have the most important group of voters in this election._** In 2024, more than 155 million votes were cast. In a typical midterm, closer to 100 million people show up. That means tens of millions of Americans who vote for president skip the midterms, and a lot of them would vote for Democrats if they voted at all. **Republicans are counting on those voters staying home. Our job is to make sure they don’t.** That’s what our team at Equal Opportunity Now is focused on right now: getting Democratic voters to the polls, especially the ones who usually sit midterms out. Reminding them an election is happening. Helping them make a plan. Making sure they know where to go and when. It isn’t glamorous. It doesn’t make headlines. You won’t see it in a TV ad. But I’ve been in close races, and I can tell you this is where they’re decided. When a race comes down to a few hundred votes, these are the voters who decide it.
