Let me lay out the facts of the race for you.
There are 5 days until the polls close. And unlike most other states, the vast majority of New Hampshire voters cast their ballot on Election Day.
_**So believe me when I say this final stretch truly matters.**_
We're being massively outspent, and every decision we make now could be the margin between a win and a loss.
I've been here before -- I've won four times in one of the "swingiest" districts in the country. To win the whole Granite State, I know I'll need you with me. New Hampshire voters are still making up their minds, and we have to stay competitive these last few weeks.
**[We're running out of time, and I need your help today. Will you chip in $15 today to help power our campaign through to November 3rd?](https://substack.com/redirect/648afb92-5ecd-4277-99d9-83c9fce11a97?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Every dollar you contribute right now will help reach voters across New Hampshire during the most important part of this race.
Thank you,
Chris Pappas

To compete with their millions, we need you.
But with just 5 days left of this campaign, we're running out of time to close this gap and keep New Hampshire blue.

| | | | | | Peter,

I'm Stacy's operations director, and I'm writing because we're five days out from Election Day and putting the final touches on our Election Night Party. I want to make sure you're on the list.
Here's what you need to know: **The party is next Tuesday, November 3, starting at 7:00 PM at Stone Hedge Golf Course, 55 Stone Hedge Drive in Tunkhannock.**
Stacy will be there with her team as the results come in from across Pennsylvania.
---
| [RSVP NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/8I2pb4CbLhO?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
---
| |
The most important detail: **every guest needs their own RSVP.** If you're bringing your spouse, kids, or a few friends, please register each of them so we have an accurate headcount.
And if you've got a friend or neighbor who's been on the fence about this race, invite them too. There's no better way to see what this campaign is about than spending election night with the people who built it.
See you Tuesday,
Emily W.Operations DirectorGarrity for PA

I’m reaching out today to send you your **2027 Hillsdale College calendar.** I know, I know. It’s a little early to be thinking about 2027. But since you care about liberty and education, I wanted to make sure you had a chance to get the 2027 calendar. **Claim your 2027 Hillsdale College calendar before October 31** **by clicking on this secure link:** [https://secure.hillsdale.edu/donate/2027-calendar](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckU2K3DAQhU8j72ykkttuL7wYxu0hkJ4h9CJLUyOV3QWyZPQzIbcPDZ0cINv6iu_Bez-vyxXZsd_ecaeRU1pssAtuvOY1xN-h4FpyibSG6PiTFpDQ1UrWMCxoMn_R0mJlxxOo83quaFT9oLXsz7Kt7qNa285aVL1u-5NeoTN2lacTyq7DXiuseHz4lIQBlNSgGiuJwLadAQntJ0jRynJYzNSwT2wpmRCOIzjObFIT4la58Z7zkYR-ETALmBOZEqm5s3PJoqOGbBEw2-Axk4AZJPS1QUfeYhR6TrTt5PNrsCT0JDXo4UXK-fV6eZs-psvlJqAreV9SKNE8Xo4Y0kEms9-eaCfLZRd6oh3ZPY8G9wN580JP_9KeJPhMPgs9ff94f1t-9PW3263-W0QVR3v8Yuc4db1o5fZwNibsVf7feb5G-BMAAP__DrOfnw) **Just in the last year, our dedicated supporters have helped to...**
* **Teach 5 million Americans in Hillsdale’s** **_free_** **online courses** , including “Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution,” and “Marxism, Socialism, and Communism”—which exposes the misery and brutality of communist regimes and the rise of Cultural Marxism in America.
* **Distribute hundreds of thousands of free copies of the Constitution** to citizens nationwide—especially younger Americans, and thousands of K-12 students.
* **Provide an American classical education** to young students nationwide through K-12 education programs, returning excellence and proper civics instruction to K-12 classrooms.
* **Expand the circulation of** **_Imprimis_** , Hillsdale’s monthly digest of liberty, to more than 7.5 million households and businesses.

I hope you’ll claim your **2027 Hillsdale College calendar** so that next year, you’ll remember how you’ve advanced the important work of defending liberty through education. Remember, your support is especially crucial because we refuse every penny of government funding—even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. NOT. ONE. PENNY—to remain INDEPENDENT. Your generosity, and that of tens of thousands of people like you, reaches and teaches millions of Americans nationwide. You’ll help enroll millions more Americans in free online courses, expand the readership of _Imprimis_ , and restore excellence to K-12 education. **Please show your support today by making your best tax-deductible gift of $50, $75, or $150—or the best gift you can—by clicking the secure link below:** [https://secure.hillsdale.edu/donate/2027-calendar](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckU2K3DAQhU8j72ykkttuL7wYxu0hkJ4h9CJLUyOV3QWyZPQzIbcPDZ0cINv6iu_Bez-vyxXZsd_ecaeRU1pssAtuvOY1xN-h4FpyibSG6PiTFpDQ1UrWMCxoMn_R0mJlxxOo83quaFT9oLXsz7Kt7qNa285aVL1u-5NeoTN2lacTyq7DXiuseHz4lIQBlNSgGiuJwLadAQntJ0jRynJYzNSwT2wpmRCOIzjObFIT4la58Z7zkYR-ETALmBOZEqm5s3PJoqOGbBEw2-Axk4AZJPS1QUfeYhR6TrTt5PNrsCT0JDXo4UXK-fV6eZs-psvlJqAreV9SKNE8Xo4Y0kEms9-eaCfLZRd6oh3ZPY8G9wN580JP_9KeJPhMPgs9ff94f1t-9PW3263-W0QVR3v8Yuc4db1o5fZwNibsVf7feb5G-BMAAP__DrOfnw) And when you do, I’ll send you your **2027 Hillsdale College calendar**. But please act _before_ October 31. Thank you for considering joining the ranks of our Hillsdale supporters. Your generosity is needed now more than ever. Warm regards,Bill Gray, ’01

Trump said earlier this year that he's willing to send ICE and National Guard troops to polling places. Markwayne Mullin, head of the Department of Homeland Security, wouldn't rule out ICE from showing up to voting locations to address so-called, unspecified "threats." The White House should have unequivocally ruled out such a clearly illegal act of voter intimidation, but it won't, because they want to spread fear before the midterms. Congress must speak out now against sending ICE and troops to the polls, then pass legislation to protect the vote from armed, authoritarian scare tactics. Democratic Senators have introduced two pieces of legislation that double down on prohibiting armed military and federal agents from terrorizing polling places: the Protect Our Polls Act and the Safe Access to the Polls Act. "President Trump is pulling every lever he has to weaponize the federal government and undermine our elections — and that includes him threatening to send armed federal agents to our polling places ," said Senator Tammy Baldwin, sponsor of the Safe Access to the Polls Act. Trump fired independent election monitors, installed election deniers in key administration positions, threatened criminal charges against states who don't follow his anti-democratic election orders, and launched an all-out attack on mail voting — moves that present direct threats to voting on November 3rd. Under Trump and Stephen Miller's mass deportations policy, ICE continues spreading violence and fear through our communities. Nobody knows how this ends except the voters who show up, and the donors who make sure we can reach them. = I know you've been getting asked for a lot this cycle, and that is because the stakes in this race are real. | This is Texas’ closest legitimate shot at a statewide democratic win in more than 30 years. The Lieutenant Governor controls the Texas Senate calendar, decides which bills get a hearing and which ones die, co-chairs the state budget board, and appoints every committee. Dan Patrick has used that power aggressively for years to attack public schools, reproductive healthcare, and against families just trying to get by. We arefive days away from bringing change to Texas. The polls are split because this race is genuinely close. Fellow Patriot,
I was a freshman at West Point when the Twin Towers fell.
None of us who were there will ever forget that morning. We'd signed up to serve a country at peace. By that afternoon, every cadet in my class knew we'd be going to war.
Not one of us flinched.
Over nine combat tours in Afghanistan and Iraq, I flew the Apache attack helicopter and then MH-47G Chinooks with the 160th SOAR "Night Stalkers," carrying special operators into places most Americans will never see. I did it because I love this country more than I love my own life. Every man on those birds felt the same way.
**And I’m still committed to fighting for this country today – but what I see happening here at home terrifies me.**
_Here 's why._
America has never been beaten from the outside. After Pearl Harbor, we rallied and won a world war. After 9/11, we took the fight to the terrorists who attacked us. Give our warfighters what they need and put them on any battlefield against any enemy on earth – and we win.
Abraham Lincoln understood this almost 200 years ago. He said the danger to America would never come from abroad. "If destruction be our lot," he warned, "we must ourselves be its author and finisher."
**That 's exactly what the radical Left is doing. Brick by brick, they're tearing America down from the inside.**
**_Our sovereignty?_** They threw open our southern border and allowed cartels to smuggle in dangerous drugs and criminals. They voted against requiring proof of citizenship to vote. A nation that can't control who comes in or who casts its ballots isn't a nation for long.
**_Our culture?_** They sneer at the flag, the troops, and the Constitution those troops swore to defend. Faith, family and hard work – the things that built this country – they treat as something to be ashamed of.
**_And our kids?_** That's what keeps me up at night. The Left wants our children taught that America is rotten to the core. That the greatest gift they'll ever receive – being born American – is something to apologize for.
A generation that's taught to hate its country won't defend it. And the socialists know it.
Today's Democratic Party isn't the party your parents knew. Socialists from the DSA wing are running the show now. And the so-called moderate, pro-America Democrats? They've had every chance to stand up to this monster. They've proven they either won't or can't.
_So it 's up to us._
**And in just a matter of days, the socialists have a real shot at taking back the House.**
Our majority is razor-thin. Democrats don't need a wave – they need to flip just a handful of seats. **Every single race in the country is on the table, and they 're pouring money into all of them at once.**
If they pull it off, Hakeem Jeffries gets the gavel. And the socialists get the keys.

[ stdin# ]Josh Shapiro for Pennsylvania
Derek,

I’ll be honest: If everyone reading this email chipped in $5 before
Saturday’s midnight deadline, we would knock our End-of-Month fundraising
goal out of the park and head into these last five days of the election in
a much stronger position.

I really mean that,
Derek.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/21920?t=1001&akid=854%2E245147%2E2vsE3E ]So I’m humbly asking: Will you chip in $5 before Saturday’s critical
deadline to help us fund the last-minute operations we need to win in
battleground Pennsylvania?

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/21920?t=1002&akid=854%2E245147%2E2vsE3E ]Chip in $5 →

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/21921?t=1003&akid=854%2E245147%2E2vsE3E ]Other →

$5 from one person may not sound like a lot in a state as expensive as
Pennsylvania.

But $5 from a whole lot of people helps us keep our ads running, reach
undecided voters, respond to the far-right’s attacks, and organize across
Pennsylvania.

I know not everyone can give to these emails, and I understand that. But
if $5 fits in your budget, it would make a real difference,
Derek.

Because my far-right opponent doesn’t need every voter to know the truth
about my record. She just needs enough outside money, enough attacks, and
enough confusion to flood this race and muddy the waters.

Our job is to make sure that doesn’t happen.

We need voters to hear what we’ve delivered, what’s at stake, and what
Pennsylvania could lose if we fall short.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/21860?t=1004&akid=854%2E245147%2E2vsE3E ]But that takes serious resources. So
Derek, please chip in $5 or
whatever you can before our last End-of-Month deadline to help us defend
Pennsylvania and put us in the strongest possible position to win on
Tuesday night.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your

Hi team,
Tonight we're wrapping up our town hall tour in Pottsville. I chose this as the last stop because this is where it all began.
This is where I grew up, this is my home, and this is where I decided to get in the fight.
I'll tell you about that in a second, but I have to ask for your help first. We're five days out and so close to winning this thing. **[Please chip in if you can to push us over the finish line.](https://substack.com/redirect/25fe568e-d820-4b43-8e59-f41a7ab0f1fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
When I first considered running for Congress last year, I went to my family to see what they thought. My cousin said something that has stuck with me throughout this campaign:
**" Run, but do it in a way where you bring people together."**
That's what I've tried to do. And you know what? It's not hard. Because we really do agree on the things that matter most. That was clear at every one of the town halls we've held this month.
[CHIP IN](https://substack.com/redirect/25fe568e-d820-4b43-8e59-f41a7ab0f1fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Our part of PA knows what Congress needs to do. Lower costs. Hold health insurance companies accountable. Take on fraud and corruption. Stand up to data centers so our communities get a say. Show up, listen, and fight for us.
**That 's why I'm running, and that's why I know we can win this.**
But I really need your support in these last few days.
**[Will you chip in to help me fight for our part of PA in Congress?](https://substack.com/redirect/25fe568e-d820-4b43-8e59-f41a7ab0f1fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ DONATE NOW](https://substack.com/redirect/25fe568e-d820-4b43-8e59-f41a7ab0f1fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
From here, for here. Always.
Gratefully,
Rachel Wallace

It can protect the people who already have plenty of power, or it can hold them accountable when they step out of line. It is one of the most consequential positions in state government. A big part of my career has been protecting working families from powerful special interests, whether that means utility monopolies hiking electric rates or corporations squeezing consumers. My friend, Jose Javier, knows that fight firsthand. name: Jim Jordan
subject: I’ve NEVER emailed you like this before…
body:
But at this final moment, you’re truly my last hope.
| **_A PERSONAL LETTER FROM THE DESK OF JIM JORDAN_**
---
Friend,
---
I know you get spammed with desperate fundraising messages at the end of the month, so I’ve never written to you about monthly deadlines before.
---
Instead, I always put in the work and do my best to ensure we hit our benchmarks well before any potential fundraising cutoff.
---
And here’s what most fundraising messages never tell you...
---
_Truth be told, under normal circumstances, you can just fix a fundraising shortfall in one month by raising more the following month!_
---
But the last deadline of an election is different. Because once the polls close on election night, there’s no going back. There is no “next month” to make up the difference. The results are FINAL. You either win or you lose.
---
**So, since this Saturday, October 31st, is the real,_final_ deadline of the midterms – _and we’re running out of time to raise the funds we need_ – I had no choice but to make an exception.**
---
I’ll be honest and up front with you: __We need AT LEAST another $25,000 in our accounts before the close-of-books.__
---
That’s not some random number I just made up on the spot. That’s a real goal, set by our team, to ensure my leadership account has the vital funds needed to WIN the biggest toss-up congressional races in the nation.
---
And at this FINAL moment that will decide the fate of the President’s Majority, _YOU_ are the FINAL place left for me to turn, Friend!
---
_I’m dead serious. At this point I’m out of options – I don’t have any wealthy donors I can call up, and I refuse to resort to spam or fake matches to try to get grassroots donations._
---
**My only hope of raising the remaining funds we need before this last deadline is to personally write this honest appeal directly to grassroots conservatives like _YOU_. **
---
Of course, I’d never ask you to do something I wouldn’t do myself.
---
**That’s why I’ve put my money where my mouth is by transferring a total of _$6.62 MILLION_ _away from my own accounts_ to help WIN the battleground races that will decide the midterms.**
---
**At this FINAL deadline, can I count on YOU to stand with me and match my commitment to saving the President’s Majority?**
---
The __amount__ you give isn’t what’s important. Instead, what matters is the __sheer__ __number__ of patriots who answer my call and have our back when we need it most!
---

clean_body: But at this final moment, you’re truly my last hope. | A PERSONAL LETTER FROM THE DESK OF JIM JORDAN Friend, I know you get spammed with desperate fundraising messages at the end of the month, so I’ve never written to you about monthly deadlines before. Instead, I always put in the work and do my best to ensure we hit our benchmarks well before any potential fundraising cutoff. And here’s what most fundraising messages never tell you... Truth be told, under normal circumstances, you can just fix a fundraising shortfall in one month by raising more the following month! But the last deadline of an election is different. Because once the polls close on election night, there’s no going back. There is no “next month” to make up the difference. The results are FINAL. You either win or you lose. So, since this Saturday, October 31st, is the real,final deadline of the midterms – and we’re running out of time to raise the funds we need – I had no choice but to make an exception. I’ll be honest and up front with you: We need AT LEAST another $25,000 in our accounts before the close-of-books. That’s not some random number I just made up on the spot. That’s a real goal, set by our team, to ensure my leadership account has the vital funds needed to WIN the biggest toss-up congressional races in the nation. And at this FINAL moment that will decide the fate of the President’s Majority, YOU are the FINAL place left for me to turn, Friend! I’m dead serious. At this point I’m out of options – I don’t have any wealthy donors I can call up, and I refuse to resort to spam or fake matches to try to get grassroots donations. My only hope of raising the remaining funds we need before this last deadline is to personally write this honest appeal directly to grassroots conservatives like YOU. Of course, I’d never ask you to do something I wouldn’t do myself. That’s why I’ve put my money where my mouth is by transferring a total of $6.62 MILLION away from my own accounts to help WIN the battleground races that will decide the midterms. At this FINAL deadline, can I count on YOU to stand with me and match my commitment to saving the President’s Majority? The amount you give isn’t what’s important. Instead, what matters is the sheer number of patriots who answer my call and have our back when we need it most! Thank you, Jim Jordan Paid for by Team Jordan a joint fundraising committee authorized by and composed between Jim Jordan for Congress, Buckeye Liberty Fund, and American Liberty Foundation PAC. PO Box 909, Marysville, OH 43040

I wanted you to hear this from me first.
**A brand-new poll out this morning shows me leading Greg Abbott, 49% to 46%.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3246abc1-7ab7-4acc-940c-e74caef34536?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Here's why that number matters so much. In early October, we had cut Abbott's lead to just 1.3 points. Then the polls started moving back his way. His lead in the polling average grew, and a lot of insiders decided this race was slipping away from us.
_**This poll was taken in the middle of early voting, and it shows us ahead.**_
What makes it remarkable is this: Greg Abbott has now spent $181 million in this race, _five times_ what our campaign has spent. In the last month alone, he spent $35 million. **That 's as much as we've spent since the day we launched.**
**Spending: TX-GOV**
🔴 Abbott, total: $181 million
🔴 Abbott, last 30 days: $35 million
🔵 Our entire campaign: $35 million
He has outspent us 5 to 1. **But we 're outworking him, and grassroots supporters are the reason why.**
I'm not going to pretend one poll settles anything. Three points is within the margin of error, and Abbott isn't going to stop spending now. The voters who decide this race are about to be buried in his ads. **We have to make sure they hear from us too.**
**That 's why my team set a goal to raise $3 million this week, and as of writing this, we're 87% of the way there.**
You've already stepped up this month, and polls like this one are what your support makes possible. I hate to ask again, but these are the final days when a dollar can still reach a voter before Election Day.**[Will you please chip in $5 one more time so we can finish what we started?](https://substack.com/redirect/3246abc1-7ab7-4acc-940c-e74caef34536?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[DONATE ->](https://substack.com/redirect/3246abc1-7ab7-4acc-940c-e74caef34536?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
We closed a 7-point gap once already. Abbott has spent $181 million trying to stop us, and today we're ahead. Let's take Texas back.
Thank you for everything,
Gina

We're confident in the infrastructure we've built, and we know that our candidates have what it takes to win. This is the moment when we need to come together, cut through the noise, and focus on what actually matters: Getting voters to the polls. = | = Early voting is almost over, and our team is on the ground working to turn out every last voter. EMILYs List staff and volunteers spent this past weekend in New Jersey and Pennsylvania, knocking doors and having the one-on-one conversations that will make all the difference in our women's razor-thin races. Here are a few photos from the road: = = This is what your grassroots support makes possible. In races like these — races that could be decided by just a handful of votes — every door knocked, every phone call made, and every voter reached makes a difference. And with just five days left, we can't afford to leave anything on the table. The stakes of this election couldn't be higher. We're fighting to elect women who will protect our rights and freedoms for years to come, and who will put a real check on the Trump administration's chaos and cruelty. | | There are just a few days left until Election Day, and the stakes this year could not be higher. My team and I have had meaningful conversations with voters during our doorbelling events around our district. **Each and every person we have spoken to has an issue on the ballot this year that could impact their lives.** Whether it is the impact the climate crisis is having on their ability to get homeowners insurance; the skyrocketing costs of groceries each week; the impact of the opioid epidemic; or concerns about the Chaos Caucus working to undermine access to Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid — everyone has something on the line. This is not just about one race; it is about mobilizing voters to make their voices heard at _every_ level of government. Every office, from the local to the federal, has a role in making progress where it matters most to Washingtonians. That is why our team is working hard to ensure voters in Washington's 2nd District and beyond are ready to turn out in full force. **With just days left, we cannot leave anything up to chance. Every moment counts, and every resource we invest now could be the difference between success and setbacks on Election Day.** We need to make sure voters are not only informed but energized to support candidates who will stand up for their interests — from county offices to Congress. clean_body: Their concerns are just the tip of the iceberg. | | | | There are just a few days left until Election Day, and the stakes this year could not be higher. My team and I have had meaningful conversations with voters during our doorbelling events around our district. Each and every person we have spoken to has an issue on the ballot this year that could impact their lives. Whether it is the impact the climate crisis is having on their ability to get homeowners insurance; the skyrocketing costs of groceries each week; the impact of the opioid epidemic; or concerns about the Chaos Caucus working to undermine access to Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid — everyone has something on the line. This is not just about one race; it is about mobilizing voters to make their voices heard at every level of government. Every office, from the local to the federal, has a role in making progress where it matters most to Washingtonians. That is why our team is working hard to ensure voters in Washington's 2nd District and beyond are ready to turn out in full force. With just days left, we cannot leave anything up to chance. Every moment counts, and every resource we invest now could be the difference between success and setbacks on Election Day. We need to make sure voters are not only informed but energized to support candidates who will stand up for their interests — from county offices to Congress. = Just $7 can help ensure we can reach voters in every corner of Northwest Washington. = Together we can ensure that these final few days count. I want to share our numbers with you.
As of 2pm CT today we have 113,729 voters that we have personally met, helped register or confirm registration, and are now helping to turn out to vote.
**46.2% of those voters have already voted. That compares to 32.1% statewide.**
That means that the voters we’re organizing are turning out at roughly one and a half times the rest of the state.
That 14-point gap is the result of thousands of Powered by People volunteers personally meeting and registering young Texans, staying in touch with them to answer questions and help them make a voting plan and then continuing to encourage them 1:1 until we can confirm that they’ve voted.
This work is only possible because people like you donated to ensure we had the resources to get it done.
We’re off to a good start, but there’s still a long way to go. In 2024 we were able to turn out more than 79% of our voters. Even though that was a Presidential election and this is a midterm, I’d like to see if we can top it.

**I never imagined that I would become one of Donald Trump’s most outspoken opponents.**

I grew up in a working-class, conservative Catholic family in El Paso, Texas. My mother was a Mexican immigrant who became an American citizen. My father was a lifelong truck driver. The Fourth of July was practically sacred in our home.

I was raised to believe in hard work, personal responsibility, service and love of country.

After September 11th, I felt called to serve. I went to work at the Pentagon, spent a year in Iraq and served our country in national-security and counterterrorism positions under both Republican and Democratic presidents.

Eventually, I was asked to serve as Vice President Mike Pence’s homeland security and counterterrorism adviser.

I sat in the Situation Room. I staffed the White House Coronavirus Task Force. I entered those rooms believing that, no matter our political differences, everyone entrusted with the security of the American people would understand that the country came first.

Then I saw what was really happening behind closed doors.

**I watched Donald Trump treat a deadly pandemic like a political and public-relations problem. I watched expertise get dismissed, the truth get bent and dedicated public servants get pushed aside because they would not place loyalty to one man above their oath to the country.**

Decisions that affected millions of American families were repeatedly reduced to one question: What was best for Donald Trump?

For a long time, I told myself that staying meant I could help. That perhaps I could prevent something worse from happening.

But eventually, I had to ask myself a much harder question:

Was I helping protect the country -- or was my presence helping legitimize something I knew was dangerous?

In 2020, I resigned from the Trump administration. Then I went public.

I was terrified.

I knew speaking out could cost me my career, my livelihood and my family’s safety. The attacks came quickly. There were threats, smears and attempts to intimidate me into silence.

But silence costs more.

So I spoke out. I supported Joe Biden. I stood on the stage at the Democratic National Convention and supported Kamala Harris. And after spending most of my life as a Republican, I eventually became a Democrat.

Not because every belief I held changed overnight. Not because I suddenly agreed with every Democrat on every issue.

I became a Democrat because there comes a moment when party loyalty becomes complicity -- and country must come first.

Now, Trump is back in the White House, the guardrails are weaker, and Republicans in Congress have repeatedly chosen obedience over oversight. MAGA is no longer merely threatening to abuse power. We are living with the consequences.

**That is why I am writing to you today on behalf of Resist Reclaim Rebuild.**

Resist Reclaim Rebuild is a group of Democratic activists working to defeat MAGA candidates in the battleground races that will determine whether Donald Trump continues to enjoy virtually unchecked power -- or whether we elect a Congress capable of standing up to him.

They understand that resistance cannot exist only in speeches, television interviews, or social media posts.

It MUST reach the ballot box.

It MUST be organized.

And it MUST be focused on the races where a relatively small number of votes could mean the difference between a MAGA rubber stamp and a real check on Donald Trump’s power.

[**So, I'm asking personally: Will you donate $10, $25 or whatever you can afford today to help Resist Reclaim Rebuild defeat MAGA in the battleground races that matter most?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142481661/657058135/-323302678?refcode=261012_rrr_troye&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjAwMzEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZGM2MjM0OTktZTdkMy1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAyMjQ4MjRkNGRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=3gj_QMfDD_isMHsvE2vOO7PVaubg6fcC46vB2e6bu7c=)[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142481662/657058136/949025562?refcode=261012_rrr_troye&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjAwMzEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZGM2MjM0OTktZTdkMy1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAyMjQ4MjRkNGRiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=3gj_QMfDD_isMHsvE2vOO7PVaubg6fcC46vB2e6bu7c=)

As a father, that moment meant everything to me. My daughter got to speak with the first Black woman to serve as Vice President of the United States - someone who broke an extraordinary barrier, and is now helping her dad break another. We’re seeing record early voting turnout in South Carolina. Our polling shows us within just TWO POINTS of MAGA Alan Wilson when voters hear about our vision for a New South Carolina. Hi Peter, Today is the last day to vote early in Tennessee, and being able to afford gas, groceries, and healthcare is on the ballot. Trump and Tennessee Republicans promised to make life more affordable. Instead, they sold us out to enrich their billionaire buddies and build gilded ballrooms, while we pay more for groceries, rent, healthcare, and just about everything else. Trump and Republicans dragged us into a war with Iran, and fuel prices have shot up ever since. Tennessee farmers are on track to pay nearly $32 million more for diesel this harvest. Worse, Trump officials now admit the $8 billion in fuel relief Trump “promised” farmers won’t come until close to the end of the year. That’s their “America last” agenda at work. Every Tennessee family is feeling it at the pump, the grocery store, and the kitchen table. Tennessee Democrats are fighting for something better. We’re working to lower costs, expand healthcare access, and make your life better. That fight starts at the ballot box. Our organizers are out knocking doors, making calls, and sending texts to make sure Tennesseans have everything they need to vote. And our Voter Protection Hotline, 833-DEM-VOTE, is ready to help every eligible ballot get counted. ### **The Good, the Bad**
The bearded man in a lime-green polo, khaki shorts, and glasses stepped to the podium inside the Hillsborough County Center. It was August 28, 2026, and the county commissioners were preparing to vote on a deal involving millions of taxpayer dollars for a new Tampa Bay Rays stadium.
After thanking the commissioners for the opportunity to speak, he introduced himself.
"My name is Brian Lambert. I'm here as a taxpayer, a resident, a Libertarian candidate for Congress and someone who genuinely wants our region to thrive. I want to be clear from the start: I love baseball, but it is not fair to ask that the entire community should carry the cost."
Hours later, the commission approved the deal 5-2.
Brian's plea had not changed the outcome. That weekend, he took his argument to the people who would be among the first to feel the good and bad effects of the development.
I first met Brian at a speaking engagement hosted by the Veterans Council of Hillsborough County, back when I was still a candidate in the same race. My first impression was of an everyday professor: soft-spoken and intelligent. Not the kind of man who commands a room. The kind who watches it and then goes to work.
I tagged along with him that weekend. Early in the morning, we began knocking on doors in Drew Park, a heavily Hispanic neighborhood of working-class families. Some answered their doors in pajamas, looking at us with unmistakable surprise.
"I'm Brian Lambert, the Libertarian candidate for District 14. I'm here today to ask what you think about the new deal."
By the time we arrived at what we had decided would be the last door before breaking for lunch, a young Caucassion woman in her early twenties answered. Wearing a white tee and boxer briefs, she pulled out her earbuds.
"Honestly, I heard about it, but I haven't had much time to look into the whole thing," she answered.
"Has anyone from the Rays, any local, state or federal office, or any candidate for office come here to discuss the development and ask about your concerns?"
Her answer was the same as all the others. A resolute no.
Over the course of the election cycle, Brian and I had come to share many coffees and a couple of beers. We talked about the grueling, tedious, and all-too-comedic life of a service member, elections past and present, and the art of balancing married and political life.
Lambert took his jacket off and draped it over the back of his seat. "When a candidate starts off with, 'I didn't serve but . . .' that's when you lose me. You don't say that to a group of veterans and then ask for their vote."
I laughed and agreed with him. "But see, they won't ever understand what it means to serve your country, not for political gain, but for freedom's sake. We served to do our part while others were getting rich and rubbing shoulders with the elite. But hey, I'd take the worst day in the military over the life of an establishment candidate anytime."
Brian laughed, then sipped his beer. "Why did you run?" he asked.
"Why does anyone run? What made us decide to take on even more work and responsibility?"
"Then what makes you support and vote for a candidate: politics or character?"
I sat with that question. Politics or character?
### **" Don't Give Up, Brother, You Got This, Todd!"**
My mind went back to a morning in the military, to a tire pit and a man who was struggling to make it to the end.
Three hours into the low crawl through the tire pit, I finally made it to the end of my last lap. Snot was dripping from my nose, blackened by the dust from the pit. The whole company had also reached the end, save one. Todd with 2 d's was still in the center of the pit, struggling. His arms were trembling, barely able to pull himself forward. I took a moment to breathe the clean air, elated at finally ending my torment.
"Todd! Get to the end now or get up and go back to the starting position and do it all over again!" yelled the Staff Sergeant.
"Give up, Todd, you aren't gonna make it, wimp!" some bald schmuck said from the crowd.
Todd stopped moving. Head sunk into the tire pit, arms flopped to his sides.
"Come on, Todd, you got this, man! Push it, Todd! You freaking got this!" Private Ramos shouldered his way through the crowd to the end of the pit, facing off against the staff sergeants observing the spectacle.
"Pathetic and weak," spat out the bald schmuck.
One of the staff sergeants yelled, "Alright, Todd, back to the beginning."
Todd got up, his face red from the exertion, black from the dust. He ran with every ounce he could muster back to the beginning to low crawl the pit once again, though slower now.
"Come on, Todd! You got this, brother!" Ramos said, punching his palm.
The bald schmuck laughed.
Ramos wiped his face. Then he was back in the pit, low crawling beside Todd.
"Todd!" he roared, turning to face him. "Don't give up, brother, you got this, Todd!"
The bald schmuck could not be heard.
Todd grabbed at the tires and pulled his limp body forward.
My heartbeat had slowed to normal. "Come on, Todd, we're with you." My hands were black and bloody. "You got this." I wiped my nose and ran in, throwing myself onto the ground beside my brothers. "Let's go!"
One by one, half the company joined us, each taking his place beside us.
A wall of voices shattered the silence.
"Go, Todd!"
"Come on, brother!"
"Push, push, push!"
We all made it to the finish line.
### **Is It All Worth It?**
Back at the restaurant, our waiter set our burgers on the table. Lambert was still looking at me, still waiting for an answer.
"Brian, after the ballots have all been cast and counted, after all the social media posts with the images of _I Voted_ stickers have been buried under the feed of holiday cheer and shenanigans, and after all the promises made yesterday by the winners are long forgotten. After everything . . . is it all worth it?"
He didn't need to answer for me to know what he would say. Perhaps he had answered long ago, when he signed on that dotted line. Today, his answer was in his hands, in the path his shoes had traveled, in the redness the sun had left on his skin.
That answer is unshaken and unspoiled.

**-- Gavriel Soriano**
**Every One A King**

**But she instilled in me the values of education and hard work.** _When the power was cut off, I did my homework by candlelight._ And thanks to the relentless determination of generations before me, I graduated from college and law school before starting my career as a federal and state prosecutor – where I served on the frontlines of justice for more than 20 years.
**Now I’m running for Attorney General to be the people’s lawyer.** Georgians deserve leadership that will put them first, and protect our families and businesses from fraud, predatory practices, and bad corporate actors.
Under Republican leadership, this office has prioritized special interests over people. As Attorney General, I’ll work for you. **[If you’re with me, could you split a donation between my campaign and Nick Brown? subject: Get The Facts - Official Voter Guide: 1st Congressional District
body:
Get the facts for Tuesday's Election. Here is a voter guide outlining where candidates stand on the issues.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/16Z4CRA_nUB?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)
| | | | | | **Official 1st Congressional District****Voter Guide**
---
| | There are 5 days until Election Day and the contrast is clear.
Mitchell Berman and his out-of-state, dark money supporters are trying to hide his record. But you deserve to know the truth.
Below is a voter guide outlining the radical policies and record of Mitchell Berman.**Please read this and forward it to your friends and family.**
Wisconsin families should know the truth about Mitchell Berman’s radical priorities and history of left-wing activisim. If he’s hiding this from you, what else is he hiding?
---
| | **Lowering Costs for Working Families** ❌ **Berman supports higher taxes on working families:** Mitchell Berman [**opposed legislation**](https://us.list-manage.com/dWzCv61FcCR?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)**** that delivered no tax on tips and overtime, an enhanced Child Tax Credit, and a new $6,000 senior tax deduction.
**✅ Steil supports lowering taxes and voted to put more money back in your pocket:** Bryan Steil voted for no tax on tips, no tax on overtime, an enhanced child tax credit, and the new $6,000 senior deduction. These changes increased tax refunds for working families by an average of over 10%.
Steil was also a leader on the [**Housing Affordability Law**](https://us.list-manage.com/Qe7Dm1VDys4?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)**** passed earlier this year. The bill increases housing supply and lowers costs by reducing government regulation, cutting red tape for building and lending, and addressing high housing costs.
Steil also stopped a [**$1,500 tax increase**](https://us.list-manage.com/xm2sR2teQ9O?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc) on Wisconsin families.
---
|
---
| | **Cleaning up Washington Corruption** ❌ **Berman Opposed the Stock Trade Ban Bill:** Berman opposed Steil’s bill to ban members of Congress from trading stocks. He has also run [**false attacks**](https://us.list-manage.com/j67Xx5yjlaQ?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc) on Steil and the legislation.
**✅ Steil Authored the Bill to Ban Members from Trading Stocks:** Steil is working to clean up Washington from the inside. He authored the [_**Stop Insider Trading Act**_](https://us.list-manage.com/cBxFhP5SAtE?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc) to ban members of Congress from trading stocks. This is the first ever stock trading ban to pass the floor of the House.
Steil does not trade stocks and believes in transparency. He makes his finances public every year.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/ar4NbWnGWYC?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)
| | **Educational Opportunity and Safe Schools** ❌ **Berman caused an elementary school lockdown with students inside:** In 2023, Berman was [escorted out of Raymond School](https://us.list-manage.com/19rk6aXw1fb?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc) after confronting officials, amid threats to staff. The school went into lockdown.
Berman [**admits**](https://us.list-manage.com/8v5XmTovU_Q?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)**** on camera that his actions led to the lockdown.
Records show the superintendent said “My [staff] does not need to be harassed at 7:15 in the morning.”
Berman [**reportedly**](https://us.list-manage.com/mZlQSqvDjmG?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)**** recorded the interaction, but to date has not released records from the lockdown
**✅ Steil Supports Educational Choice and Safe Schools:** Steil helped pass the [**$3,400 Education Freedom Tax Credit**](https://us.list-manage.com/1Cq8I9D0_k1?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)**** to support educational opportunities for students and families. Steil has a record of supporting educational opportunities and empowering families to make the best choice for their own children.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/17HfucaPQ_k?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)
| | **Campaign Finance Transparency** ❌ **Berman lies about Corporate PAC Funding:** Berman [**looks directly into the camera**](https://us.list-manage.com/1Cz0Sm07pj2?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)**** and promises not to take corporate PAC money in one ad. But that ad is paid for a group that is funded by millions in Corporate PAC money. When confronted, Berman refused to admit to the lie despite [**reporting**](https://us.list-manage.com/R0Ej2VmnL8K?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)**** highlighting the coverup.
Berman was also accused of [**violating federal campaign finance law**](https://us.list-manage.com/14YHHWPLStS?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc) earlier this year.
**✅ Steil Believes in Transparency:** Steil makes his donations publicly available. He also led the charge to crack down on illegal and fraudulent donations, authoring the [**bipartisan** _**Campaign Finance Transparency Act**_](https://us.list-manage.com/KaoiqA61Z1I?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc) _._ His bill updates campaign finance disclosures for the digital era and institutes new safeguards and transparency measures.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/pi2BBKbnPn8?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)
| | **Healthcare Reform** ❌ **Berman lies about healthcare funding in Wisconsin:** Berman repeatedly claims that Medicaid was cut for Wisconsin families and that changes in federal law will harm working families. [**Reporting**](https://us.list-manage.com/ErylCdEh62n?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)**** and nonpartisan analysis shows that WI healthcare funding increased by [**10%.**](https://us.list-manage.com/nXQcdzI8uIu?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)
But when confronted him during the debate, Berman [**acknowledged that healthcare funding in Wisconsin increased by $1 billion**](https://us.list-manage.com/ymj7I3FAogW?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)**.**
**✅ Steil invested in WI Healthcare:** Steil secured a [**$1 billion increase**](https://us.list-manage.com/16SRGrLCHFp?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)**** in Wisconsin healthcare funding to support working families and help lower costs. He also helped pass reforms that prevent fraud in important programs and protect them for who they were designed to serve.
Steil also passed [**legislation**](https://us.list-manage.com/fVxBFw8AZRl?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)**** to take on insurance companies and their middlemen, force companies to cover what doctors prescribe, and make sure savings are passed on to patients at the pharmacy counter.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/2gsfpoJkquq?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)
| | **Waste, Fraud, and Abuse and Work Requirements** ❌ **Berman Opposes Work Requirements and Eliminating Waste, Fraud, and Abuse:** Berman [**opposed**](https://us.list-manage.com/gTRRF9sNGve?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc) H.R. 1, which included work requirements of 20 hours a week for able-bodied childless adults to receive taxpayer benefits. That same bill instituted additional fraud prevention standards.
Berman is [**endorsed by Tim Walz**](https://us.list-manage.com/nSw2c7sspbs?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc) , who oversaw Minnesota’s $250 million fraud scandal.
**✅ Steil Supports Work Requirements and is Fighting Fraud:** Steil voted to [**pass**](https://us.list-manage.com/xb62GXCGR5C?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc) work requirements of 20 hours a week for able-bodied, childless adults to receive taxpayer funded benefits.
He also is working to prevent fraud in important programs like Medicaid to ensure they are protected for the Americans they were designed for: pregnant women, children, and disabled Americans.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/IZ9CEty6tCg?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)
| | **Law Enforcement and Safe Communities** ❌ **Berman would defund federal law enforcement:** Berman has called for [defunding federal law enforcement](https://us.list-manage.com/1CPCRC8KSxE?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc). He was [**criticized by law enforcement**](https://us.list-manage.com/FwMHaOAxUtu?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc) in a recent ad for his dangerous actions and radical agenda.

**✅ Steil Supports Law Enforcement and Opposes Efforts to Defund Them:** Steil voted to fund law enforcement and opposes the defund the police movement. He is [**endorsed**](https://us.list-manage.com/1rM03fRIXFw?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)**** by the Milwaukee Police Association, Kenosha Professional Police Association, and our Sheriffs.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/12aoTKvMxXG?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)
| | **Free Benefits for Illegal Immigrants** ❌ **Berman supports taxpayer-funded benefits for illegal immigrants:** Berman opposed the legislation to prevent illegal immigrants from receiving taxpayer funded healthcare. Berman also called for defunding federal law enforcement efforts to deport violent-criminal illegal aliens.

**✅ Steil Voted to Remove Free Taxpayer-Funded Benefits from Illegal Aliens:** Steil voted to prevent illegal aliens from receiving free taxpayer-funded healthcare. He also voted to secure our border, to help fight drug trafficking and make our communities safer.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/G07YpLY7VPx?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)
| | **This coming Tuesday, you will have the opportunity to decide which vision is right for Wisconsin.**
Bryan Steil was born and raised in Southeast Wisconsin and is working every day to deliver results for our community. He is focused on making life more affordable for you. Bryan is committed to protecting and preserving Social Security and Medicare for our Seniors. And he is leading the charge to clean up Washington.
Mitchell Berman is not from our community. [**Berman**](https://us.list-manage.com/11MiGCe4cxe?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)**** registered to vote in a house that was not built, sued a local school board, and triggered an elementary school lockdown. He opposes work requirements for able-bodied childless adutls to receive taxpayer funded benefits. He’s called for defunding federal law enforcement and has a radical history of supporting socialists like Bernie sanders.
---
| | **WE NEED YOU TO VOTE AND SHARE THIS WITH YOUR FRIENDS AND FAMILY!**
Election Day is November 3, and every vote matters. Early voting is already underway.
**Make your plan to vote on or before November 3! Find your polling location**[**here**](https://us.list-manage.com/bQNLOxV3QS3?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)**.**
**Let’s help Bryan win this November!**
---
| | | | | [Donate](https://us.list-manage.com/S43JLVxPlZ2?e=e907534017&c2id=1a88483f2d815518aac54ccc59c1b6bc)
---
| | _**Team Steil**_
---
|
---

Steil for Wisconsin, Inc. * PO Box 103 * Oak Creek, WI 53154-8618 * USA
[update your preferences](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/profile?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=5ab9944a1c&e=e907534017&c=dc6dd9ea38) or [unsubscribe](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=5ab9944a1c&t=b&e=e907534017&c=dc6dd9ea38)

body:
[ https://act.robsand.com/go/12134?t=1013&amount=25&akid=1632%2E412644%2EAv8wI1 ][IMG]

Folks, we’re just 5 days away from Election Day, and the polls
are painfully close. This really is anyone’s race.

Between that and Zach Lahn’s $1M/week attack ad blitz, the stakes couldn’t
be higher this week.

Bottom line? We’re running out of time to reach voters before they cast
their ballots, and I need your help to maximize our efforts over the final
few days of this neck-and-neck race.

We’ve got to hit our daily digital fundraising goal before midnight to
bolster our ads through the home stretch, and we’re cutting things way too
close. [ https://act.robsand.com/go/12134?t=1014&amount=25&akid=1632%2E412644%2EAv8wI1 ]Will you please chip in a quick grassroots donation to help get
my campaign message in front of folks?

[ https://act.robsand.com/go/12134?t=1015&amount=25&akid=1632%2E412644%2EAv8wI1 ]DONATE

I want to give you fair warning that this email is longer than usual, but
I do hope you’re able to spare a couple of minutes to read the whole
thing.

Election Day is just 5 days away, and my team and I have outlined our game
plan for the remainder of this neck-and-neck race.

But if you’re in a hurry and you don’t have time to read it all, my
feelings won’t be hurt (too badly 😂). [ https://act.robsand.com/go/12134?t=1016&amount=25&akid=1632%2E412644%2EAv8wI1 ]But if you’re able to chip in a
quick grassroots donation toward our daily fundraising goal, that would
really make my day.

[ https://act.robsand.com/go/12134?t=1017&amount=25&akid=1632%2E412644%2EAv8wI1 ]DONATE

If you’ve made it this far — hey 👋 thanks for being here.

Right, so this is obviously oversimplifying things a bit, but in the
spirit of not emailing you an entire novel, I did my best to distill our
campaign’s plan into three BIG action items:

Everything, Everywhere, All at Once

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

The most important thing we can do to set ourselves up for success is talk
to as many people as possible, in as many places as possible.

Look, people get their news and consume media differently. While I’ve
already spoken to loads of people in person, some folks probably first
heard about my campaign on social media, while others might have learned
about it through TV, their newspaper, or the radio.

The point here is that there are still a TON of people who’ve yet to hear
from us, and others still who might not even know much about the election
or my background.

Zach Lahn is spending $1 million every week on ads to attack me and smear
my record, and it’s mission-critical that we’re able to cut through the
noise so folks hear from us, too.

Because we know that once folks hear about my vision for a better, more
equitable Iowa that puts people over politics, they’re very, very likely
to support our campaign.

That’s why even though we’ve already wrapped up my 100 Town Hall Tour,
we’re still pulling every lever we can to talk to Iowans and expand our
outreach.

Focus on the Issues that Matter

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Everywhere I go, Iowans — regardless of their political leanings — tell me
they’re sick of partisan talking points and a government that doesn’t work
for them.

They understand that partisan insiders and special interests are pulling
the strings, gaming the system, and putting politics over people — all
while pitting communities against one another.

They’re concerned about rising costs, farm foreclosures, and losing
opportunities to neighboring states as our economy continues to decline.

That’s why we’re talking about bringing jobs back to Iowa and making sure
our kids have the same opportunities we did. We’ve got a plan to bring
opportunity and innovation back to our state, and make it a place where
folks want to stay and raise a family, or start a small business.

Build the Biggest Grassroots Coalition in Iowa History

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Traveling the state, meeting with voters, having important conversations,
holding town halls and other community events... It's a lot.

But it’s 100% necessary, and it’s how we’re going to win.

Taking on the powers that be and the insiders isn’t easy, and Zach Lahn
has already gotten more than $15 million from his partisan backers at the
Republican Governors Association.

But we’ve got something they don’t: This grassroots team.

It’s growing bigger by the day as more folks hear from us, but we can’t
afford to slow down now. We need to continue growing our grassroots
network and laying the groundwork for victory, and empowering people to
have conversations about the importance of this race.

We’ve got a plan to win this thing, and I’m confident that if we can
execute on all three of these action items, we’ll be in good shape.

[ https://act.robsand.com/go/12134?t=1018&amount=20&akid=1632%2E412644%2EAv8wI1 ]Our campaign coffers are running low, and this race is getting tighter
by the day, which makes hitting our daily fundraising goal that much more
important. Can I count on you to fuel our efforts through the final days
of this race by chipping in
$20
today?

[ https://act.robsand.com/go/12134?t=1019&amount=20&akid=1632%2E412644%2EAv8wI1 ]Donate
$20

[ https://act.robsand.com/go/12134?t=1020&amount=25&akid=1632%2E412644%2EAv8wI1 ]Other Amount

I really appreciate you taking the time to read all this!

—Rob Sand

[ https://act.robsand.com/go/918?t=1001&akid=1632%2E412644%2EAv8wI1 ][IMG]

Rob has built a coalition of support that crosses party lines because he
knows we can only move Iowa forward together. If you’re able to support
his campaign today you can chip in here:

We believe that emails are the best way for our organization to stay in
touch with supporters like you. But if you'd like to receive fewer emails,
[ https://act.robsand.com/signup/fewer_emails/?t=1004&akid=1632%2E412644%2EAv8wI1 ]click here.

If Chris Pappas wins this race, we’re one step closer to halting Trump’s extremism and protecting our democracy.

It’s Senator Chris Murphy.
**If we want to flip the Senate and put the brakes on Donald Trump’s dangerous agenda, we need to win in New Hampshire – and that means sending Chris Pappas to the U.S. Senate.**
I know Chris. He’s thoughtful. He’s grounded. He’s laser-focused on helping working families get ahead, not scoring political points. And he’s never afraid to stand his ground when it matters most.
That’s exactly the kind of leadership we need more of in Washington. **[If you agree, can you pitch in $10 today to power Chris’s campaign?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261029_4.EwJvmK&refcode=em20261029-4&t=2&akid=9867%2E582294%2EjXrAYh)**

Republicans know how important New Hampshire is, which is why the Granite State is one of their top targets as they try to hold onto their Senate majority.
National GOP leaders are bullish about their chances to flip this open Senate seat. And they’re spending _tens of millions of dollars_ to make it happen.
Between national party committees, corporate PACs, and mega-donors, massive amounts of money are flooding the airwaves to attack Chris and prop up his GOP opponent, John Sununu. Outside Republican groups have pumped in over $66 million in ad spending.
There is almost no path to a Democratic Senate majority without New Hampshire. If Chris wins this race, we’re one step closer to halting Trump’s extremism and protecting our democracy.
And look – I know a lot gets asked of grassroots supporters. But I wouldn’t be asking if this race wasn’t enormously important.
Chris has what it takes. He just needs the resources to stay competitive and win against the millions flooding the airwaves.
This is a fight we can win – but it will require all of us. Chris is counting on grassroots donors like you:

Derek, Republicans

name: Finance Team (via California Democrats)
subject: Not what you’d think
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the California Democratic Party | www
body:
We just made one of the final budget decisions we’ll make before the polls close on Tuesday. |
---
| We just made one of the _final_ budget decisions we’ll make before the polls close on Tuesday, team. "If there's one thing that Trump said that was hateful, what was it?" the comedian asked the liberal activist.
"Oh God,... I apologize because sometimes being put on the spot, you can't think of a thing..." she replied, struggling to think of one real example.

* * *
# **Obama-era FBI found marriage fraud evidence against Ilhan Omar**
The FBI and DHS under Obama investigated Rep. Ilhan Omar's 2009 marriage to Ahmed Nur Said Elmi, whom some allege is her brother, finding evidence of potential marriage fraud but declining prosecution after the five-year statute of limitations expired, **[the New York Times reports.](https://substack.com/redirect/334a4f9d-3a36-4c98-9a5e-4fc258863f38?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/334a4f9d-3a36-4c98-9a5e-4fc258863f38?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Elmi obtained a provisional green card through the marriage before abandoning his application for permanent status** and leaving for the UK after immigration officials sought additional information. Omar, who has repeatedly denied Elmi is her brother, divorced him in 2017; marriage fraud and sibling marriage are both illegal under federal and state law, respectively.
* **Obama called the current Trump-era investigation into Omar "appalling"** and politically motivated following the October search of her D.C. home, which yielded her phone, notebook, and reportedly DNA evidence, though his statement didn't address the earlier FBI findings under his own administration.
* **More red flags:** Discrepancies in Omar's stated birth year -- 1982 on some records versus 1981 elsewhere, including her own memoir -- have fueled scrutiny over whether she was old enough to qualify for derivative citizenship through her father.

* * *
# **ICE deportations hit historic high in September**
Border czar Tom Homan announced ICE deported **[more migrants in September than any month in the agency's history,](https://substack.com/redirect/8540b662-df58-4a2e-a596-652fa8b4f716?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** following record monthly arrests from June through August, crediting the enforcement surge with helping drive crime rates down nationally.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8540b662-df58-4a2e-a596-652fa8b4f716?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Homan criticized New York 's new law barring local police from cooperating with ICE,** saying agents will instead conduct neighborhood operations that could sweep up additional illegal immigrants beyond their original targets when jail-based cooperation isn't available.
* **CBP Commissioner Rodney Scott separately touted** 18 consecutive months without releasing illegal border crossers into the country.
* **Addressing a DHS data breach exposing over 40,000 employee names,** Homan said the Justice Department is investigating while emphasizing that ICE agents face rising threats despite having families of their own.

* * *
# **Alaska 's "spoiler Sullivan" controversy surfaces after thousands already voted**
A New York Times investigation found operatives connected to Democratic candidate Mary Peltola and the DSCC **[allegedly coordinated to recruit Dan J. Sullivan](https://substack.com/redirect/cb604b90-009c-4fda-b432-873507ccaba4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , a same-named spoiler candidate, into Alaska's Senate race. Text messages and documents suggest Peltola was aware, though her campaign and the DSCC deny involvement.
* **The report 's timing means roughly 58,000 Alaskans, nearly 10% of registered voters, may have already cast ballots** before learning of the alleged scheme, which critics argue was designed to confuse voters targeting incumbent Sen. Dan Sullivan.
* **The DOJ has sued to potentially delay certification if Sullivan loses,** citing voter confusion risks compounded by Alaska's ranked-choice system -- a process state Sen. James Kaufman says some traditionalist voters refuse to fully engage with, potentially skipping one of the two "Sullivans" on the ballot altogether.

* * *
# **Student reads disturbing poem mocking Charlie Kirk 's death aloud at TPUSA event**
A University of Texas at San Antonio student **[read a poem celebrating"the Kirkaversary"](https://substack.com/redirect/ea97781d-f856-4c7f-8389-ae936b7e915f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** of Charlie Kirk's assassination at a Turning Point USA event, drawing cheers from the crowd before telling event speaker Christian Collins he was "brave" for appearing without a "neck brace."

clean_body: It's starving my family and soon yours too. | | | ** My name is Jamie Davis, I'm a 3rd generation farmer and the Democrat nominee for US Senate in Louisiana. My grandfather was a sharecropper and farmed land he would never own, today I farm that same land, only today we work over 3,200 acres and own over 700 of those acres. We tow equipment across those acres everyday.My Dodge Ram 3500 is what I use to do it - it runs on diesel. Right now it costs thousands more to fuel it - the profit margins for farming are tight, I cannot afford this. If this continues we'll lose our farm, everything we've fought for over three generations. This is our last stand \- I'm running to end the Iran war and lower prices for you and me. Against all odds, Democrats lead this race for the 4th consecutive day of early voting and Louisiana is #1 in the nation for Black turnout. It’s a narrow 2851 vote lead but a lead is a lead. But I'll be honest,DC Dems have written my campaign off. Consultants think I'm too unpolished. Hi friends,
Welcome to Team Wiley. This is where we'll keep you posted on what Wiley's up to and how you can stay involved. Glad you're here.
Quick note before Election Day.
We're partnering with the Wake County Democratic Party to hold an election night watch party on Tuesday, November 3rd at The Rialto, along with Christine Kushner and Mona Singh, our at-large candidates for Wake County Commissioner. Doors open at 8:30 PM. There'll be snacks, sodas and a cash bar.
**The Rialto**
**1620 Glenwood Avenue
Raleigh, NC 27608**
It's free, but you need a ticket. [Grab yours here.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/91579489-e3d6-4e94-b01e-5fb75d78ef33?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Wiley doesn't have an opponent this time, so he'll mostly be there to thank the volunteers and grassroots Democrats who knocked doors, made calls and showed up all year, and to root for Christine, Mona and the rest of our Democratic candidates. We'd love to see you there.
Also, please save the date. Wiley will be sworn in as Wake County's next District Attorney on Tuesday, January 5th at 1:00 PM at the Wake County Justice Center. We'll share more details soon.
Thanks for all you've done to get us here.
Team Wiley
